a: Lo haya karev. amar lo: mi hem hallalu shemmemehem anu shotim ushemotam en anu mazkirim? amar leh: bene adam shebbikkeshu laakor kevodcha uchevod bet avicha.

Amar leh: "gam ahavatam gam sinatam gam kinatam kevar avada"! amar leh: "haoyev tammu choravot lanetzach". amar leh: hane mille hecha deahano maasayyhu, rabbanan la ahano maasayyhu! hadar atni leh, amru mishshum rabbi meir: illu haya temura lo haya karev. amar rava: afillu rabbi deinvevtana hu (tena), "amru mishshum rabbi meir". "amar rabbi meir" la amar.
Amar rabbi yochanan: peligu ba rabban shimon ben gamliel verabbanan, chad amar: sinay adif, vechad amar: oker harim adif.

Rav yosef sinay, rabba oker harim. shelachu letamman: eze mehem kodem? shelachu lehu: sinay adif, deamar mar: hakkol tzerichin lemare chittayya, vaafillu hachi la kabbel rav yosef aleh. melach rabba esrin vetarte shenin, vahadar melach rav yosef. vechol shene dimlach rabba, rav yosef afillu ummana leveteh la (chalef).

Abbaye verava verabbi zera verabba bar matna havo yatvi vahavo tzerichi resha, amri: kol deamar milleta vela mipperich, leheve resha. dechullehu ipperich, deabbaye la ipperich. chazyeh rabba leabbaye digva reshe, amar leh: nachmani, petach veema.
Ibbaya lehu: rabbi zera verabba bar rav matna he minnayyhu adif? rabbi zera charif umakshe, verabba bar rav matna matun umassek, may? teku.
Hadaran alach kohen mashiach, uselika la massechet horayot.
Mishna kol hazzevachim shennizbechu shello lishman – kesherim, ella shello alu labbealim leshem chova; chutz min happesach vehachattat – happesach bizmanno, vehachattat bechol zeman.

Rabbi eliezer omer: af haasham – happesach bizmanno, vehachattat vehaasham bechol zeman. amar rabbi eliezer: hachattat baa al chet, vehaasham ba al chet; ma chattat – pesula shello lishmah, af haasham – pasul shello lishmo.
Yose ben choni omer: hannishchatin leshem pesach uleshem chattat – pesulin.
Shimon achi azarya omer: shechatan leshem gavoah mehen – kesherin, leshem namuch mehen – pesulin.

Ketzad? kadshe kadashim sheshshechatan leshem kodashim kallim – pesulin, kodashim kallim sheshshechatan leshem kodshe kodashim – kesherin. habbechor vehammaaser sheshshechatan leshem shelamim – kesherin, shelamim sheshshechatan leshem bechor uleshem maaser – pesulin.
Gemara lema li lemitna "ella shello alu"? litne "velo alu labbealim leshem chova"!
Ha ka mashma lan: labbealim hu dela alu leshem chova – aval bikdushetayyhu kayymi, veasur leshannoye behu.
Vechidrava, deamar rava: ola sheshshechatah shello lishmah – asur lizrok damah shello lishmah.
Ibbaet ema sevara, ibbaet ema kera. ibbaet ema sevara: mishshum deshanni ba – kol hane lishanne ba velezil?!
Ibbaet ema kera: "motza sefatecha tishmor veasita, kaasher nadarta laAdonai elohecha nedava vegomer" – hay nedava?!
b: Neder hu! ella im kema shennadarta asita – yehe neder, veim lo – nedava yehe;
Unedava mi shere leshannoye ba?
Amar leh ravina larav pappa: la havet gabban beureta bitchuma be charmach – derame rava mille mealleyayta ahadade, veshanni lehu.
May mille mealleyayta? tenan: kol hazzevachim shennizbechu shello lishman kulei. tama deshello lishman; ha setama – alu name labbealim leshem chova; alma setama name kelishman dame.
Ureminhi: kol hagget shennichtav shello leshem ishsha – pasul. usetama name pasul!
Veshanni: zevachim – bistam lishman omdin, ishsha – bistama lav legerushin omedet.

Uzevachim bistama kesherin menalan? illema meha ditnan: kol hazzevachim shennizbechu shello lishman kulei – vela katane "shello nizbechu lishman"; gabbe get name, hakatane: kol hagget shennichtav shello leshem ishsha pasul – vela katane "shello nichtav leshem ishsha pasul"!
Ella meha ditnan: ketzad lishman veshello lishman? leshem pesach uleshem shelamim. tama deamar leshem pesach uleshem shelamim, ha leshem pesach usetama – kasher; alma setaman kelishman deme.
Dilma shane hatam, deamar: kol haose – al daat rishona hu ose!
Ella missefa: shello lishman velishman – leshem shelamim uleshem pesach. tama deamar leshem shelamim uleshem pesach, ha setama uleshem pesach – kasher.
Dilma shane hatam, deamar: yochiach sofo al techillato!
I name, ayyeyde ditna "lishman veshello lishman", tena name "shello lishman velishman"!
Ella meha: leshem shishsha devarim hazzevach nizbach – leshem zevach, leshem zoveach, leshem shem, leshem ishshim, leshem reach, leshem nichoach. vehachattat veasham – leshem chet.
Amar rabbi yose: af mi shello haya belibbo leshem achat mikkol ellu – kasher, shettenay bet din hu. atno bet din dela lema "lishmo", dilma ate lememar "shello lishmo".
Vei salka datach setama pasul, kayymi bet din umatni milleta demippesil beh?!
Vegabbe get distama pasul – menalan?
Illema meha ditnan: haya over bashshuk, veshama sofrim makrin: "ish peloni gerash pelonit mimmakom peloni", veamar: "ze shemi veze shem ishti" – pasul legaresh bo.
Dilma kidrav pappa – deamar rav pappa: hacha besofrim haasuyin lehitlammed askinan; vela ikketuv leshum keritut kelal!
Ella meha:

a: Yater al ken, katav legaresh et ishto venimlach, metzao ben iro veamar lo: "shemi keshimcha veshem ishti keshem ishtecha" – pasul legaresh bo.
Dilma shane hatam, deinnetik leh leshem gerushin dehahu!
Ella meha: yater al ken, yesh lo shete nashim sheshshemotehen shavot – katav legaresh et haggedola, lo yegaresh bo et hakketanna.
Dilma shane hatam, deinnetik leh leshem gerushin dehahi!
Ella meha: yater al ken, amar lelavlar: ketov, uleeze sheertze agaresh – pasul legaresh bo.
Dilma shane hatam, deen berera!

Ella meha: hakkotev tofse gittin – tzarich sheyyanniach mekom haish umekom haishsha umekom haedim umekom hazzeman. veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: af tzarich sheyyanniach mekom "hare at mutteret lechol adam".
Tu rame milleta achariti – mi amar rav yehuda amar rav: chattat sheshshechatah leshem ola – pesula, shechatah leshem chullin – keshera; alma demina machariv ba, delav mina la machariv ba?!
Ureminhu: kol hagget shennichtav shello leshem ishsha – pasul. vaafillu leshem goya name pasul!
Veshanni: get – dal goya minneh have leh setama, usetama pasul. kadashim – dal chullin minnayyhu have leh setama, usetama kesherim.
Urema milleta achariti: mi amar rav yehuda amar rav: chattat sheshshechatah leshem ola – pesula, shechatah leshem chullin – keshera; alma deminna machariv ba, dela minna la machariv ba?!
Vehatanya: "tocho" – velo toch tocho, vaafillu keli shetef matztzil!
Veshanni: chullin etzel kadashim – kimchitza etzel tannur; ma mechitza etzel tannur la mahneya la kelal, af chullin etzel kodashim la mahneya leh kelal.
Ditnan: tannur shechatzatzo binsarim o biriot, venimtza sheretz bemakom echad – hakkol tame.
Kavvevret shehi pechuta ufekuka bekash, umeshuleshelet laavir hattannur – sheretz betochah, hattannur tame; sheretz battannur, ovchalin shebbetochah temein. verabbi eliezer metaher.
Amar rabbi eliezer: kal vachomer! im hitztzil bemet – hechamur, lo tatztzil bichli cheres – hakkal?!
Amru lo: lo;
b: Im hitztzil bemet chamur – shekken chaluka beohalin, tatztzil bichli cheres hakkal – sheen chalukin beohalin.
Hatinach lerabbanan; lerabbi eliezer may ikka lememar?
Rabbi eliezer kal vachomer kaamar.
I hachi, hatam name lema kal vachomer: kodashim mechallelin kodashim – chullin lo kol shekken?!

Ella tama derav – kerabbi elazar; deamar rabbi elazar: may tama derav? "velo yechallelu et kodshe bene yisrael et asher yarimu laAdonai" – kodashim mechallelin kodashim, veen chullin mechallelin kodashim.
Alma ata kera appekeh mikkal vachomer; hacha name – lete "tocho" lappekeh mikkal vachomer!
Hay "tocho" – mibbee leh loovchalin sheggibbelan betit, vehichnisan laavir tannur. salka datach amena: hoil uvingia lo metamme, baaviro name la metammu [ka mashma lan].
Verabbanan – hanach la tzerichi kera.
Rav yosef bar amme rame shinnuy kodesh ashshinnuy bealim, umeshanne.
Mi amar rav: chattat sheshshechatah leshem chattat – keshera, leshem ola – pesula; alma delav mina machariv ba, demina la machariv ba?!
Vehaamar rav: chattat sheshshechatah al mi shemmechuyyayv chattat – pesula, al mi shemmechuyyayv ola – keshera; alma devar mina machariv ba, delav mina la machariv ba!
Umeshanne: hatam "veshachat otah lechattat" amar rachamana, vahare chattat leshem chattat nishchata.
Hacha "vechipper alav" ketiv – alav velo al chavero; chavero dumeya dideh, shemmechuyyayv kappara kemotah.
Rav chaviva rame shinnuy bealim attoch tocho, umeshanne.
Umi amar rav: chattat sheshshechatah al mi shemmechuyyayv [chattat – pesula, al mi shemmechuyyayv] ola – keshera; alma demina machariv ba, lav mina la machariv ba?!
Vehatanya: "tocho" – velo toch tocho, afillu keli shetef matztzil!
Umeshanne: arbea "tocho" ketivi (tocho) – "toch", "tocho", "toch", "tocho".
Chad – legufeh; vechad – ligzera shava;
Chad – tocho shel ze velo tocho shel acher; iddach – "tocho" velo toch tocho, vaafillu keli shetef matztzil.

a: Menalan devaenan zevicha lishmah? deamar kera: "veim zevach shelamim korbano" – shettehe zevicha leshem [shelamim].
Vedilma hayeynu shemayyhu!
Middichtiv "hammakriv et dam hashshelamim", "hazzorek et dam hashshelamim" – vela ketiv "zevach"; vehacha ketiv "zevach"; shema minna: shettehe zevicha leshem shelamim.
Ashkechan zevicha, shear avodot menalan?
Vechi tema lelaf mizzevicha; ma lizvicha – shekken nifsela shello leshem ochlin bappesach!
Ella amar kera: "hammakriv et dam hashshelamim" – shettehe kabbala leshem shelamim.
Velichtov rachamana bekabbala, velelaf shechita minna!
Mishshum deikka lemifrach – ma lekabbala shekken pesula bezar veishsha.
Ashkechan shechita vekabbala, zerika menalan?
Vechi tema lelaf mehane – ma lehane shekken teunot tzafon, veyeshnan bechattaot happenimiyyot!
Ella amar kera: "hazzorek et dam hashshelamim" – shettehe zerika leshem shelamim.
Velichtov rachamana bizrika, velelaf minna!
Mishshum deikka lemifrach – ma lizrika, shekken chayyayv aleha zar mita.
Ashkechan kullehu, holacha menalan?
Vechi tema lelaf mikkullehu; ma lechullehu – shekken avoda shei efshar levattelah; tomar beholacha – sheefshar levattelah?!

Ella amar kera: "vehikriv et hakkol hammizbecha", veamar mar: zo holachat evarim lakkevesh; vetanya: "vehikrivu" – zo kabbalat haddam; veappek rachamana bilshon holacha – lememra deholacha la tappeka mikkelal kabbala.
Veashkechan shinnuy kodesh, shinnuy bealim menalan?
Amar rav pinchas bereh derav amme, amar kera: "uvesar zevach todat shelamav" – shettehe zevicha leshem toda. im eno inyan leshinnuy kodesh – denafka lan mehatam; tenehu inyan leshinnuy vealim.

Vehay lehachi hu daata?! ha mibbee leh lechidtanya: "uvesar zevach todat shelamav" – abba chanin omer mishshum rabbi eliezer: ba lelammed, toda sheshshechatah leshem shelamim – keshera, shelamim sheshshechatan leshem toda – pesula. ma hefresh ben ze laze? toda keruya shelamim, veen shelamim keruyin toda.
Anan mizzevach" kaamrinan.
Veakkatti mibbee leh: chattat veasham minnayin? talmud lomar "zevach"!
Im ken, nichtov kera: "uvesar todat shelamav [zevach]"; may "zevach"? shema minna tarte.
Ashkechan zevicha, shear avodot menalan?
Vechi tema lelaf mizzevicha – ma lizvicha shekken posel shello leshem ochlin bappesach!

Neemra zevicha beshinnuy kodesh, veneemra zevicha beshinnuy vealim; ma zevicha haamura beshinnuy kodesh – lo chillakta ben zevicha lishar avodot, af zevicha haamura beshinnuy vealim – lo techallek bahen ben zevicha lishar avodot.
Ikka lemifrach: ma leshinnuy kodesh – shekken pesulah begufah, veyeshno bearba avodot,
Veyeshno leachar mita, veyeshno betzibbur kivyachid!
b: Veaf al gav detarte lav davka, tarte miha davka.
May shena shinnuy vealim dela have pesulo begufo – machshava bealma; shinnuy kodesh name machshava bealma hu! ella kevan deachsheva – pasla; hacha name, kevan deachsheva – pasla.
Ulerav pinchas bereh derav mari, deamar yesh shinnuy vealim leachar mita – tarte miha ikka lemifrach!
Ella amar rav ashe, amar kera: "venirtza lo lechapper alav" – velo al chavero.
Vehay lehachi hu daata?! hay mibbee leh lechidtanya: "venirtza lo lechapper alav" – rabbi shimon omer: et shealav – chayyayv beachrayuto, veet sheeno alav – eno chayyayv beachrayuto.
Veamar rav yitzchak bar avdimi: may tama? kevan deamar "alay" – keman detaun leh akkatpeh dame.
Rav ashe mivvenirtza lo lechapper" kaamar.
Ashkechan zevicha uzerika, kabbala menalan?
Vechi tema lelaf mizzevicha uzerika – ma lizvicha uzerika shekken avoda shechayyayvin aleha bachutz!

Ella amar rav ashe: atya meel nazir; dichtiv: "veet haayil yaase zevach shelamim" – shettehe asiyyayto leshem shelamim; veim eno inyan leshinnuy kodesh – denafka leh mehatam, tenehu inyan leshinnuy vealim.
Amar leh rav acha bar abba lerava, ema: "yaase" – kalal, "zevach" – parat; kelal uferat – en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat; zevicha in, midde acharina la!
I ketiv "yaase shelamim zevach" – kidkaamrat; hasheta dichtiv "yaase zevach shelamim" – have leh kelal sheeno male, vechol kelal sheeno male – en danin oto bichlal uferat.
Ravina amar: leolam danin, vela" chazar vechalal.

Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: veha la dame kelala kamma lichlala batra; kelala kamma – merabbe asiyyot vetu la, kelala batra – kol "laAdonai" vaafillu shefichat shirayim vehaketarat emurin! ha tanna deve rabbi yishmael bichlale uferate daresh ki hay gavvna:
Kelal uferat uchelal – i atta dan ella keen happerat; ma happerat meforash – avoda uvaenan lishman, af kol avoda uvaenan lishman.
I ma happerat meforash – avoda vechayyayvin aleha bachutz, af kol avoda vechayyayvin aleha bachutz; shechita uzerika – in, kabbala veholacha – la!
I name, ma happerat meforash – davar hattaun tzafon veyeshno bechattaot happenimiyyot, af kol hattaun tzafon veyeshno bechattaot happenimiyyot; shechita vekabbala – in, zerika – la!
Ikka lememar hachi veikka lememar hachi, shekulin hen veyavou shenehen. lishshana acharina: vachada chada teku bemilleta.
Ibbaet ema: zerika – midderav ashe nafka.
Ashkechan el nezir, shear shelamim menalan?
Vechi tema nelaf meel nazir – ma leel nazir, shekken yesh immahen damim acherim!
Im ken, nichtov "shelamav"; may "shelamim" – lerabbot kol shelamim.
Ashkechan shelamim, shear kol kodashim menalan?
Vechi tema nelaf mishshelamim, ma lishlamim shekken teunin semicha unesachim utenufat chaze vashok!

Ella amar kera: "zot hattora laola velammincha velachattat velaasham velammilluim ulezevach hashshelamim" – hakkishan hakkatuv lishlamim; ma shelamim – ben shinnuy kodesh ben shinnuy vealim, baenan lishmah; af kol ben shinnuy kodesh ben shinnuy vealim, baenan lishmah.
Ema hecha deshachet lehu shello lishmah – lippaslu!
Amar kera: "motza sefatecha tishmor veasita kaasher nadarta vegomer" – hay nedava?! neder hu! [ella] im kema shennadarta asita – yehe neder, veim lav – yehe nedava.
Veitzterich "motza sefatecha", veitzterich "zot hattora"; dei ketav rachamana "motza" – hava amena

a: La yada bemay; ketav rachamana "zot hattora". vei ketav rachamana "zot hattora" – hava amena lippaslu; ketav rachamana "motza sefatecha".
Reme resh lakish al meohi be midresha, umakshe: im kesherim hem – yeratztzu! veim en meratztzin – lamma bain?

Amar lo rabbi (eliezer) [elazar]: matzinu bevain leachar mita, shehen kesherin veen meratztzin. ditnan: haishsha shehevia chattatah umeta – yaviu yorshin olatah. olatah umeta – lo yaviu yorshin chattatah.
Amar leh: modena lach beola, deatya leachar mita; asham, dela ate leachar mita – menalan?
Amar leh: hare machloktecha betziddo – rabbi eliezer omer: af haasham.
Amar: zehu sheomrin alav adam gadol hu?! kaamena ana mishna shelema, veat amrat li rabbi eliezer?!
Ella amar resh lakish, eftach ana pitcha lenafshay: "motza sefatecha vegomer" – hay nedava?! neder hu! kulei kedilel.

Yatev rabbi zera verabbi yitzchak bar abba, veyatev abbaye gabbayyhu, veyatvi vekaamri: kashya leh leresh lakish asham dela ate leachar mita, venasev la talmuda "motza sefatecha"; ema: habba beneder uvindava – leyte vela liratztze, asham – la leyte kelal!

Amar lehu abbaye, resh lakish mehacha petach: "veshachat otah lechattat"; otah – lishmah keshera, shello lishmah pesula; ha shear kodashim – shello lishman kesherin. yachol yeratztzu? talmud lomar: "motza sefatecha".
Veema: habba beneder unedava – leyte vela liratztze, asham (name) – artzoye name liratztze!
Amar abbaye: asham demiratztze la matzet amrat, kal vachomer meola; uma ola sheenah mechapperet – enah meratztza, asham shemmechapper – eno din sheeno meratztze?!
Ma leola, shekken kalil!
Shelamim yochichu.
Ma lishlamim, shekken teunin nesachin utenufat chaze vashok!

Ola tochiach. vechazar haddin. lo rei ze kiri ze, velo rei ze kiri ze; hatztzad hashshave shebbahen – shehen kodashim, ushechatan shello lishman kesherin veen meratztzin; af ani avi asham – shehu kodesh, ushechato shello lishmo kasher veeno meratztze.
Ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen, shekken yeshno betzibbur!
Toda tochiach.
b: Ma letoda, shekken teuna lechem!

Ola ushelamim yochichu. vechazar haddin. lo rei ze kiri ze, velo rei ze kiri ze; hatztzad hashshave shebbahen – shehen kodashim, ushechatan shello lishman kasher veeno meratztze; af ani avi asham – shehu kodesh, ushechato shello lishmo kasher veeno meratztze.
Ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen, shehen bain beneder uvindava!
Ella amar rava: "zot hattora vegomer" – hikkisho hakkatuv lishlamim; ma shelamim shehen kodashim, ushechatan shello lishman kesherim veen meratztzin; af ani avi asham shehu kodesh kulei.
May chazet deakkesht lishlamim? akkesh lechattat!
Ha mayet rachamana "otah".
Yatev rav huna verav nachman, veyatev rav sheshet gabbayyhu, veyatvi vekaamri: kashya leh leresh lakish – asham dela ate leachar mita; lema leh rabbi elazar: asham name ate leachar mita!
Amar lehu rav sheshet: asham lemay karev – lemotaro; chattat name mikrav karva motara!
Chattat – af al gav dekarva motara, miet rachamana "hu".
Asham name ketiv beh "hu"!
Hahu leachar haketarat emurim hu dichtiv, kidtanya; aval asham lo neemar bo "hu" ella leachar haketarat emurin, vehu atzmo – im lo haketiru emurin kasher.
Veella "hu" lema li? lechidrav huna amar rav – deamar rav huna amar rav: asham shennittak liriyya, ushechato setam – kasher.
Nittak – in, lo nittak – la; may tama? amar kera: "hu" – bahavavyayto yehe.

Yatvi rav nachman verav sheshet, veyatev rav adda bar matna gabbayyhu, veyatvi vekaamri: ha dekaamar rabbi elazar matzinu bevain leachar mita shehen kesherin veen meratztzin – lema leh resh lakish: hanhu name leyto veliratztzo!
Amar lahen rav adda bar matna: yoledet – im hi yalda, baneha mi yaldu?!
Matkef la rav assi: uman lema lan dei ikka kamma ase gabba la mitkappera? vechevan dechi ikka kamma ase gabba mikkappera, yorsheha name mikkappar.
Lememra dekanya lehu?! vehaamar rabbi yochanan: hinniach mincha lishne vanav vamet – kereva, veen bo shuttafut. vei salka datach kanya lehu, "nefesh" amar rachamana!
Vela kanya lehu?! vehaamar rabbi yochanan: hinniach behema lishne vanav vamet – kereva, veen memirin bah. i amrat bishlama kanya lehu – hayeynu deen memirin bah, dehavya lehu keshuttafin,

a: Veshuttafin la matzu memirin. ella i amrat la kanya lehu – amore name limru!
Shane hatam, deamar kera: "im hamer yamir" – lerabbot et hayyoresh; echad memir veen shenayim memirin.
Matkef la rav yaakov minnehar pekod: ella meatta, gabbe maaser dichtiv: "veim gaol yigal" lerabbot et hayyoresh – hachi name echad goel veen shenayim goalin?!
Shane maaser, degabbe avuhon name iteh beshuttafut.
Amar leh rav assi lerav ashe: uminna – i amrat bishlama kanya lehu, hayeynu dechad miha memar; ella i amrat la kanya lehu, hechi memar?
Vehaamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: hammakdish mosif chomesh, umitkapper ose temura, vehattorem mishshello al shel chavero – tovat hanaa shello!
Mikkiva la mechappera, mikkufeya mechappera.
Ibbaya lehu: kipperu al ma shebbau, o lo kipperu?
Amar rav sheshet bereh derav idi: mistabbera delo kipperu; dei salka datach kipperu, sheni lama hu ba?
Veella may, lo kipperu?! lama hu karev?

Amar rav ashe, rav shisha bereh derav idi hachi ka kashya leh: i amrat bishlama lo kipperu – shello lishmo mikkoach lishmo kaate, vesheni lama hu ba – lechapper; ella i amrat kipperu – sheni lama hu ba?
Ibbaya lehu: aase dilachar haferasha – mechappera, o la mechappera?
Mi amrinan midde dehave achattat; ma chattat – dekodem haferasha in, dilachar haferasha la; af hacha name – dekodem haferasha in, leachar haferasha la?
O dilma la damya lechattat; dechattat – al kol chet vechet bae leetoye chada chattat, vehacha – kevan deikka kamma ase gabbeh mechappera, aase dilachar haferasha name mechappera?

Ta shema: "vesamach... venirtza" – vechi semicha mechapperet?! vahalo en kappara ella baddam, shenneemar: "ki haddam hu bannefesh yechapper"! ella ma talmud lomar: "vesamach... venirtza... lechapper"? sheim asaah lismicha sheyare mitzva – maale alav hakkatuv keillu lo kipper, vechipper.
May lav dechipper – ase dekodem haferasha, lo kipper – aase dismicha, dehave leh ase dilachar haferasha?
Amar rava: ase dismicha kaamrat?! shane hatam, dechol kamma dela shachet – baamod usemoch" kae; emat ka have ase – leachar shechita; leachar shechita la ka mibbaya lan.
Amar leh rav huna bar yehuda lerava, ema: kipper – gavra,
b: Lo kipper – kamme shemayya!

Mi la tenan: "vehannotar bashshemen asher al kaf vegomer lechapper alav lifne Adonai" – im natan, kipper; veim lo natan, lo kipper. divre rabbi akiva. rabbi yochanan [ben nuri] omer: sheyare mitzva hen; ben nittan ben shello nittan – kipper, umaalin alav keillu lo kipper.
May "keillu lo kipper"? illema demibbee leetoye korban acharina, haamrat: ben nittan ben lo nittan kipper! ella kipper – gavra, lo kipper – kamme shemayya; hacha name kipper kulei!
Hatam name, kipper – mattan behonot, lo kipper – mattenot harosh.
Ta shema, rabbi shimon omer: kivse atzeret lama hen bain?
Kivse atzeret shelamim ninhu! ella seire atzeret lama hen bain?
Al tumeat mikdash vekadashav.
Nizrak damo shel rishon, sheni lamma karev? al tumea sheora ben ze laze. emor meatta: reuyin hayu yisrael lehakeriv korbenotehen bechol et uvechol shaa, ella shechissech hakkatuv.
Veha hacha daase dilachar haferasha, veka mechappera!
I deafreshinhu bevat achat – hachi name; hacha bemay askinan – deafreshinhu beze achar ze.
Veleko velema leh likra, dechi ketiva – beze achar ze ketiva?!

Amar rav pappa: korbenot tzibbur kaamrat?! shane korbenot tzibbur – delev bet din kamatne alehen, kidrav yehuda amar shemuel; deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: korbenot tzibbur – sakkin moshachtan lema shehen.

Amar leh rav yosef bereh derav shemuel lerav pappa: umi it leh lerabbi shimon lev bet din matne alehen?! haamar rav idi bar avin amar rav amram amar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan: temidin shello hutzerchu latztzibbur –

a: Ledivre rabbi shimon en nifdin temimim, ledivre chachamim nifdin temimin!

Veod, ha bea minneh rabbi yirmeya merabbi zera: seire atzeret shekkibbel daman bishne kosot, venizrak damo shel rishon; sheni lama hu ba? al tumea sheora ben [zerika shel] ze laze. (nizrak damo shel sheni lama hu kerevin)
Ad kan la mibbaya leh – ella ase dilachar shechita, aval asa dilachar haferasha – la ka mibbaya leh!
Dilma "im timtze lomar" kaamar.
Ittemar: toda sheshshechatah leshem todat chavero (keshera) – rabba amar: keshera, rav chisda amar: pesula.
Rabba amar keshera – toda leshem toda nishchata. rav chisda amar pesula – leshum shelamim dideh nishchata baenan.

Amar rabba: mena amena la? detanya: "uvesar zevach todat shelamav beyom hakerivo et zivcho vegomer" – abba chanin amar mishshum rabbi eliezer, ba lelammed: toda sheshshechatah leshem shelamim – keshera, shelamim shennishchatu leshem toda – pesulim. uma hefresh ben ze laze? toda keruya shelamim, veen shelamim keruyin toda.
Shelamim leshem toda – pesula, ha toda leshem toda – keshera; may, lav dechavreh?
La, dideh.
Aval dechavreh may – pesula? addetane "shelamim leshem toda pesula", litne "toda leshem toda" – vechol shekken shelamim leshem toda!
Shelamim leshem toda dideh itzterich leh; salka datach amena: middetoda keruya "shelamim", shelamim name keruyin "toda" – vechi shachet lehu leshem toda likkashsheru; ka mashma lan.
Amar rava: chattat sheshshechatah leshem chattat – keshera, leshem ola – pesula.
May tama? "veshachat otah lechattat" amar rachamana, vahare chattat leshem chattat nishchata. leshem ola – pesula.
Veamar rava: chattat sheshshechatah al mi shemmechuyyayv chattat – pesula. al mi shemmechuyyayv ola – keshera.
May tama? "vechipper alav" – alav velo al chavero; chavero dumeya dideh, bimchuyyayv kappara kemoto.
Veamar rava: chattat sheshshechatah al mi sheeno mechuyyayv kelum – pesula, sheen lecha adam beyisrael sheeno mechuyyayv ase.
Veamar rava: chattat mechapperet al chayyayve ase mikkal vechomer – al chayyayve charetot mechapperet, al chayyayve ase lo kol shekken?!
Lememra devat mina hi?! vehaamar rava: chattat sheshshechatah al mi shemmechuyyayv chattat – pesula, al mi shemmechuyyayv ola – keshera!
b: Mikkiva la mechappera, mikkufeya mechappera.
Veamar rava: ola sheshshechatah shello lishmah – asur lizrok damah shello lishmah.
Ibbaet ema kera, ibbaet ema sevara. ibbaet ema kera: "motza sefatecha tishmor vegomer". ibbaet ema sevara: mishshum deshanni ba kulei, kidresh pirka.
Veamar rava: ola habbaa leachar mita; shechatah beshinnuy kodesh – pesula, beshinnuy bealim – keshera, deen bealim leachar mita.

Verav pinchas bereh derav amme amar: yesh bealim leachar mita. amar leh rav ashe lerav pinchas bereh derav amme: davka kaamar mar yesh bealim leachar mita – uvae leetoye ola achariti; o dilma, dei ikka kamma ase gabbeh mechappera?
Amar leh: davka kaamena.

Veamar rava: ola – doron hi. hechi dame? i delekka teshuva – "zevach reshaim toeva"! vei deikka teshuva – hatanya: avar al mitzvat ase veshav, lo zaz mishsham ad shemmochalim lo! ella shema minna doron hu.
Chattat al mi mechapper, ola leachar doron – siman.
Tanya name hachi, amar rabbi shimon: chattat lamma baa? lamma baa?! lechapper! ella lamma baa lifne ola? lifraklit shennichnas, [ritztza peraklit – nichnas] doron acharav.
Chutz min happesach vehachattat kulei. pesach menalan?
Dichtiv: "shamor et chodesh haaviv veasita pesach" – sheyyehu kol asiyyotav leshem pesach.
Ashkechan shinnuy kodesh, shinnuy bealim menalan?
Dichtiv: "vaamartem zevach pesach hu" – shettehe zevicha leshem pesach; im eno inyan leshinnuy kodesh, tenehu inyan leshinnuy vealim.
Ashkechan lemitzva, leakkev menalan?
Amar kera: "vezavachta pesach laAdonai elohecha vegomer".

Matkef la rav safra: hay "vezavachta" lehachi hu daata?! hay mibbee leh lechidrav nachman – deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: minnayin lemotar pesach shekkarev shelamim? shenneemar: "vezavachta pesach laAdonai elohecha tzon uvakar" – vahalo en pesach ba ella min hakkevasim umin haizzim! mikkan lemotar happesach sheyyehe ledavar habba min hatztzon umin habbakar, umay nihu – shelamim.

Ella amar rav safra: "vezavachta pesach" – lechidrav nachman; "shamor et chodesh haaviv" – lemitzva beshinnuy kodesh; "vaamartem zevach pesach" – beshinnuy bealim lemitzva; "hu" – leakkev ben hacha vehacha.
Veashkechan zevicha, shear avodot menalan? hoil vegalli – galli.
Rav ashe amar: hoil vegalli galli la amrinan. ella [avodot] menalan? dichtiv: "zot hattora laola velammincha vegomer";
Vetanya: "beyom tzavvoto et bene yisrael lehakeriv et korbenehem" – ze bechor umaaser vafesach;
Hikkisho hakkatuv lishlamim. ma shelamim – ben shinnuy kodesh ben shinnuy vealim, baenan lemitzva; af kol – ben shinnuy kodesh ben shinnuy vealim, lemitzva.

Vechishlamim; ma shelamim – ben zevicha ben shear avodot, lo chalakta bahen, lemitzva; af pesach – lo tachlok bo ben zevicha lishar avodot, leakkev. (mishshum shenneemar "hu" bizvicha – eno ella leakkev.)
Ella, "hu" lema li?
Kidtanya: neemar befesach "hu" bishchita – leakkev; aval asham lo neemar bo "hu" ella leachar haketarat emurin, vehu atzmo shello huketru emurav – kasher.
Chattat menalan? dichtiv: "veshachat otah lechattat" – shettehe shechita leshem chattat.
Ashkechan shechita, kabbala menalan? dichtiv:

a: "Velakach hakkohen middam hachattat" – shettehe kabbala leshem chattat.
Veashkechan shechita vekabbala, zerika menalan? deamar kera: "vechipper alav hakkohen mechattato" – shettehe kappara leshem chattat.
Ashkechan shinnuy kodesh, shinnuy bealim menalan? amar kera: "alav" – alav velo al chavero.
Ashkechan lemitzva, leakkev menalan? kidamar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: "chattat"–"chattato"; hacha name: "chattat"–"chattato".

Ashkechan mitzva – beshinnuy kodesh, uzerika beshinnuy bealim – ben lemitzva ben leakkev. leakkev – bechol avodot beshinnuy kodesh, uvishar avodot beshinnuy bealim – ben lemitzva ben leakkev, menalan?
Amar rabbi yona: atya mechattat nazir, dichtiv: "vehikriv hakkohen lifne Adonai veasa et chattato veet olato" – sheyyehu kol asiyyotav leshem chattat.
Ashkechan shinnuy kodesh, shinnuy bealim menalan? (im eno inyan leshinnuy kodesh, tenehu inyan leshinnuy bealim. ashkechan lemitzva, leakkev menalan?)
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: "chattat"–"chattato".
Matkef la ravina: ella meatta, "olat"–"olato" may darshat beh?
Uleravina, "minchat"–"minchato", "nesech"–"nisko", may darshat behu?
Hahu mibbee leh: "minchatam veniskehem" – ballayla, "minchatam veniskehem" – afillu lemachar. ella "olat"–"olato", may darshat behu?
Vetu, mi gamri mehadade?! chattat chelev mechattat nazir la gamra – shekken yesh immah damim acherim; chattat nazir mechattat chelev la gamra – shekken karet!
Ella amar rava: atya mechattat metzora, dichtiv: "veasa hakkohen et hachattat" – sheyyehu kol asiyyotav leshem chattat.
Veashkechan shinnuy kodesh, shinnuy bealim menaleh? amar kera: "vechipper al hammittaher vegomer" – al hammittaher ze, velo al hammittaher chavero.
Veakkatti, mi yalfa mehadade?! chattat chelev mechattat metzora la yalfa – shekken yesh immah damim acherim; chattat metzora mechattat chelev la gamra – shekken karet!
Mechada la atya, tete chada mittarte.
Behe la lichtov? [la lichtov] rachamana bechattat chelev, vetete mehanach?! ma lehanach, shekken yesh immahem damim acherim!
La lichtov rachamana bechattat nazir, vetete mehanach?! ma lehanach, shekken en lahen sheela!
La lichtov rachamana bechattat metzora, vetete mehanach?! ma lehanach, shekken en bain bedallut!

Ella amar kera: "zot hattora laola velammincha vegomer" – hikkisho hakkatuv lishlamim; ma shelamim – ben shinnuy kodesh ben shinnuy bealim, baenan lishman lemitzva; af chattat – ben shinnuy kodesh ben shinnuy bealim, baenan lishman lemitzva.
Hilkach, mitzva – mishshelamim, vehanach kerae – leakkev.
Veashkechan chattat chelev, dichtiv bah "lachattat";
b: Chattat daavoda zara, dishmiat hakkol, uvittuy sefatayim, vetumeat mikdash vekadashav – dela ketiv behu; menalan?
Chattat daavoda zara – atya mechattat chelev, shekken karet kemotah; vehanach kullehi – atyayn bema hatztzad.
Tanu rabbanan: pesach bizmanno – lishmo kasher, shello lishmo pasul; uvishar yemot hashshana – lishmo pasul, shello lishmo kasher.
Mena hane mille? amar avu dishmuel, amar kera: "veim min hatztzon korbano lezevach shelamim laAdonai" – davar habba min hatztzon yehe lezevach shelamim.
Ema shelamim in, midde acharina la! amar rabbi ila amar rabbi yochanan: "lezevach" – lerabbot kol zevach.
Ema kol deshachet – leheve kemotah!
I hava ketiv "lishlamim vezevach" – kidkaamrat; hasheta dichtiv "lezevach shelamim" – lechol deshachet leh, shelamim leheve.
Ema: "lezevach" – kalal, "shelamim" – parat; kelal uferat – en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat; shelamim in, midde acharina la!
"LaAdonai" – hadar vechalal.
Matkef la rav yaakov minnehar pekod: ha la dame kelala batra lichlala kamma; kelala kamma – merabbe zevachim vetu la; kelala batra – "laAdonai" kol dela, vaafillu leofot vaafillu limnachot!
Ha tanna deve rabbi yishmael, bichlale uferate daresh ki hay gavvna:
Kelal uferat uchelal – i atta dan ella keen happerat; ma happerat meforash – shehu shello lishmo, vechasher; af kol – shehu shello lishmo, vechasher.
I – ma happerat meforash, davar habba beneder uvindava; af kol habba beneder uvindava – ola ushelamim in, chattat veasham lo!
Ella "lezevach" – ribbuya hu.
Ema lechol deshachet leh – leheve kevavteh!
Amar rabbi avin:

a: Dochin kadashim hanneechalim etzel kadashim hanneechalin, veen dochin kadashim hanneechalin etzel kadashim sheenan neechalin.
Attu chattat veasham mi la mitachli?!
Ella dochin kadashim hanneechalin lechol adam etzel kadashim hanneechalin lechol adam, veen dochin kadashim hanneechalin lechol adam etzel kadashim sheen neechalin lechol adam.
Rabbi yose berabbi avin amar: dochin kadashim kallim etzel kadashim kallim, veen dochin kadashim kallim etzel kodshe kadashim.
Matkef la rav yitzchak berabbi (savriu) [savrin], ema: shachteh leshem maaser – leheve maaser! lemay hilcheta? dela live nesachim, ulemilke aleh (belo yimmacher) belo yiggael".
Amar kera: "haasiri yihye kodesh" – ze maaser, veen acher maaser.
Ema: shachteh leshem bechor – leheve kivchor! lemay hilcheta? dela live nesachim, i name delitteveh lechohanim.
Bechor name, "avara"–"avara" mimmaaser gamar.
Veema: shachteh leshem temura – leheve temura! lemay hilcheta? lemilke aleh, i name lemekam aleh belo yimmacher velo yiggael".
Amar mar zutera bereh derav nachman, amar kera: "vehaya hu utemurato" – zo temura, veen acher temura.
Veema: shachteh leshem toda – leheve ki toda! lemay hilcheta? lehateino lechem.
Mi ikka midde defesach gufeh la bae lechem, umotaro bae lechem?!
I hachi, hasheta name – mi ikka midde defesach gufeh la bae nesachim, umotaro bae nesachim?!
Anan hachi kaamrinan: mi ikka midde demotar toda atzmah – la bae lechem, veillu motar deatya lehu mealma – baaya lechem?!
Matkef la rav [yemar] bereh derav hillel: umimmay divmotar pesach ketiv? dilma bemotar asham ketiv!
Amar rava, amar kera: "veim min hatztzon korbano lezevach shelamim" – davar hashshave bechol hatztzon.
Matkef la rabbi avin bar chiyyay, veittema rabbi avin bar kahana: bechol atar at amrat "min" – lehotzi, vechan "min" – lerabbot!
Amar rabbi mani: hacha name "min" lehotzi – dela ate ben shete shanim, vela ate binkeva.
Matkef la rav chana bagdataa: umi matzet amrat dechi ketiv hay – bemotar pesach ketiv?! veha middichtiv "im kesev", "im ez" – mikkelal delav bemotar pesach ketiv!
Hahu mibbee leh lechidtanya: "keves" – lerabbot et happesach lealya.

Keshehu omer: "im keves" – lerabbot pesach sheibbera shenatah; ushelamim habbaim mechamat pesach – lechol mitzvat shelamim, sheyyittaanu semicha unesachim utenufat chaze veshok. keshehu omer: "im ez" – hifsik hainyan, limmed al haez sheenah teuna alya.
Veha – mehacha nafka?! middaavu dishmuel nafka, deamar avu dishmuel: "veim min hatztzon korbano lezevach shelamim" – davar habba min hatztzon yehe lezevach shelamim!

Veakkatti midderav nachman amar rabba bar avu nafka! deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: minnayin lemotar pesach shekkarev shelamim? shenneemar: "vezavachta pesach laAdonai elohecha tzon uvakar". vahalo en pesach ba ella min hakkevasim umin haizzim! ella mikkan lemotar happesach sheyyehe ledavar habba min hatztzon umin habbakar; umay nihu – shelamim.
Ella telata kerae ketivi,
b: Chad leibbera zemanno veibbera shenato, vechad leibbera zemanno velo shenato, vechad lelo ibbera lo zemanno velo shenato.
Utzerichi; dei ketav rachamana chad, hava amena: hecha deibbera shenato uzemanno – deiddechi mippesach ligmare; aval ibbera zemanno velo shenato, dachaze lefesach sheni – ema la.
Vei ketav rachamana hane tarte – mishshum deiddechi lehu mimmilletayyhu; aval hecha dela ibber lo zemanno velo shenato, dachaze lefesach – ema la; tzerichi.
Amar rav mishshemeh demavog: chattat sheshshechatah leshum chattat nachshon – keshera; deamar kera: "zot torat hachattat" – tora achat lechol hachattaot.
Yatev rava vekaamar la leha shemata; etiveh rav mesharsheya lerava, rabbi shimon omer: kol hammenachot shennikmetzu shello lishman – kesherot, vealu labbealim leshum chova;
Lefi sheen hammenachot domot lizvachim. shehakkometz machavat leshem marcheshet – maaseha mochichin aleha shehi machavat, chareva leshem belula – maaseha mochichin shehi chareva;
Aval bizvachim eno ken – shechita achat lechullan, kabbala achat lechullan, zerika achat lechullan.
Tama demaaseha mochichin, ha en maaseha mochichin – la; ammay? lema: "zot torat hammincha" – tora achat lechol hammenachot!
Ella i ittemar, hachi ittemar: amar rav mishshemeh demavog: chattat sheshshechatah al menat sheyyitkapper bah nachshon – keshera; en kappara lemetim.
Velema met bealma!
Ha ka mashma lan: tama demet; ha dechay dumeya denachshon – pesula. umay nihu? chattat nazir vechattat metzora.
Hane olot ninhu!
Ella i ittemar hachi ittemar, amar rav mishshemeh demavog: chattat sheshshechatah al shemmechuyyayv chattat kenachshon – keshera; chattat nachshon – ola hi.
Ikka deamar, amar rav mishshemeh demavog: chattat sheshshechatah leshem chattat nachshon – pesula; chattat nachshon – ola hi.
Velema: chattat nazir vechattat metzora! ikkar chattat naket.
Amar rav: chattat chelev sheshshechatah leshem chattat dam, leshem chattat avoda zara – keshera.
Leshem chattat nazir, leshem chattat metzora – pesula; hane olot ninhu.
Bae rava: chattat chelev sheshshechatah leshem chattat detumeat mikdash vekadashav, mahu? mi amrinan: karet kemotah;
O dilma, en kavua kemotah?
Rav acha bereh derava matne kullehu lifsula, may tama? "veshachat otah lechattat" – leshem otah chattat.
Amar leh rav ashe lerav acha bereh derava: baya derava hechi matnitu la?

Amar leh: anan beshinnuy bealim matnenan la [vehachi matnenan lah], amar rava: chattat chelev sheshshechatah al mi shemmechuyyayv chattat dam vechattat avoda zara – pesula. al mi shemmechuyyayv chattat nazir vechattat metzora – keshera.
Uvaayin la hachi – bae rava: chattat chelev sheshshechatah al mi shemmechuyyayv chattat detumeat mikdash vekadashav, mahu? mi amrinan: karet kemotah; o dilma, en kavua kemotah?
Teku.
Ittemar: shechatah lishmah, lizrok damah shello lishmah – rabbi yochanan amar: pesula, veresh lakish amar: keshera.
Rabbi yochanan amar pesula – mechashshevin meavoda laavoda, veyalfinan mimmachshevet piggul.
Veresh lakish amar keshera – en mechashshevin meavoda laavoda, vela yalfinan mimmachshevet piggul.
Veazdu letamayyhu – deittemar:

a: Hashshochet et habbehema al menat lizrok damah laavoda zara, ulehaktir chelbah laavoda zara – rabbi yochanan amar: asura; mechashshevin meavoda laavoda, veyalfinan chutz mibbifnim.
Resh lakish amar: mutteret; en mechashshevin meavoda laavoda, vela yalfinan chutz mippenim.
Vei ashmeinan beha – beha amar resh lakish, aval penim mippenim ema mode leh lerabbi yochanan;
Vei ashmeinan ha – beha kaamar rabbi yochanan, aval behahi ema mode leh leresh lakish; tzerichi.
Ki ata rav dimi, amar: metiv rav yirmeya lesayyoeh lerabbi yochanan, verabbi ila lesayyoeh leresh lakish.

Rav yirmeya lesayyoeh lerabbi yochanan: uma bimkom sheim amar "hareni shochet chutz lizmanno" shehu kasher, shechato al menat lizrok damo chutz lizmanno – pasul; makom sheim amar "hareni shochet shello lishmo" – pasul, shechato al menat lizrok damo shello lishmo – eno din sheyyehe pasul?!
Matkef la rava bar ahilay: ma lechutz lizmanno, shekken karet!

Ella amar rava bar ahilay, hachi kaamar: uma makom sheim amar "hareni shochet chutz limkomo" shehu kasher, shechato al menat lizrok damo chutz limkomo – pasul; makom sheim amar "hareni shochet shello lishmo" shehu pasul, [shechato al menat] lizrok damo shello lishmo – eno din sheyyehe pasul?!
Matkef la rav ashe: ma lechutz limkomo  – shekken noheg bechol hazzevachim; tomar beshello lishmo – sheeno noheg ella befesach vechattat?!

Ella amar rav ashe, hachi kaamar: uma bemakom sheim amar "hareni shochet leshem peloni" shehu kasher, lizrok damo (shello lishmo) leshem peloni – pasul; makom sheim amar "hareni shochet shello lishman" shehu pasul, [shechato al menat] lizrok daman shello lishman – eno din sheyyehe pasul?!
Rabbi ila lesayyoeh leresh lakish: lo tomar bizrika, vetete mikkal vachomer mibbenayyay mishshechita vekabbala! lemay hilcheta ketav rachamana? lomar deen mechashshevin meavoda laavoda.
Matkef la rav pappa: vedilma dimchashshevin meavoda laavoda!
Im ken, lishtok kera minneh, vetete mikkal vachomer derav ashe.
Veiddach parech hachi: ma lehanach – shekken teunot tzafon, veyeshnan bechattaot happenimiyyot!
Veiddach – hasheta miha bishlamim kayyaymin.
Ittemar: shechatah lishmah, lizrok damah shello lishmah – rav nachman amar: pesula, rabba amar: keshera. vahadar beh rabba legabbe rav nachman, mikkal vachomer derav ashe.
Rabbi eliezer omer: af (et) haasham. tanya, amar rabbi eliezer: chattat baa al chet, veasham ba al chet; ma chattat shello lishmah – pesula, af asham shello lishmo – pasul.
Amar lo rabbi yehoshua: lo; im amarta bechattat – shekken damah lemala!
Amar lo rabbi eliezer: pesach yochiach – sheddamo lematta, ushechato shello lishmo pasul.
Amar lo rabbi yehoshua: ma lefesach – shekken zemanno kavua!
Amar lo rabbi eliezer: chattat tochiach.
Amar lo rabbi yehoshua:
b: Chozrani chalila.
Chazar rabbi eliezer vedano din acher: chattat neemar bah "hi" bishchita – hi lishmah keshera, shello lishmah pesula; ufesach neemar bo "hu" bizvicha – hu lishmo kasher, shello lishmo pasul;
Af asham neemar bo "hu" – hu lishmo kasher, shello lishmo pasul.

Amar lo rabbi yehoshua: chattat neemar bah "hi" bishchita – hi lishmah keshera, shello lishmah pesula. pesach neemar bo "hu" bizvicha – hu lishmo kasher, shello lishmo pasul. aval asham, lo neemar bo "hu" – ella leachar haketarat emurin, vehu atzmo shello huketru emurin – kasher!
Amar lo rabbi eliezer, hare [hu] omer: "kachattat kaasham" – ma chattat shello lishmo pasul, af asham shello lishmo pasul.
Amar mar: amar lo rabbi yehoshua: chozrani chalila. ulemihdar dina, velayyte bema hatztzad"!
Mishshum deikka lemifrach: ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen – shekken yesh bahen tzad karet.
Amar lo rabbi yehoshua: lo; im amarta bechattat – shekken damah lemala! velema leh: lo; im amarta bechattat – shekken nichnas damah lifnay velifnim!
Bechattaot hachitzonot kaamrinan.
Sheim nichnas damah [lifnay] velifnim – pesula!
It leh lerabbi eliezer "af haasham".
Shekken mechapperet al chayyayve charetot!
Mechattat dishmiat hakkol.
Shekken teuna arba mattanot!
Kerabbi yishmael, deamar: kol haddamim (teuna) [teunin] arba mattanot.
Shekken teuna al arba keranot!
Velitamaych, haikka etzba! haikka keren! haikka chuddah! ella chad mittere telat tame naket.
Amar mar, amar lo rabbi yehoshua: lo, im amarta. lema leh rabbi eliezer: asham name damo lemala!
Amar abbaye: asham damo lemala la matzet amrat, kal vechomer meola; uma ola shehi kalil – damah lematta, asham sheeno kalil – lo kol shekken?!
Ma leola, shekken enah mechapperet!
Chattat haof tochiach.
Ma lechattat haof, shekken enah min zevach!
Ola tochiach. lo rei ze kiri ze, velo rei ze kiri ze. hatztzad hashshave shebbahen – shehen kodshe kadashim, vedaman lematta; af ani avi asham – shehu kodesh kodashim, vedamo lematta.
Amar leh rava mipparzikya lerav ashe: velifroch, ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen – shekken en lahen kitzva; tomar beasham – sheyyesh lo kitzva?!
Ella hayeynu tama derabbi eliezer, deamar kera: "hakkohen hamechatte otah" – otah damah lemala, veen damo shel acher lemala.
I hachi, chattat name nema: otah – lishmah keshera, shello lishmah pesula; ha shear zevachim – ben lishman ben shello lishman kesherin!
Hahu "otah" lav davka, deha shayyayr pesach.
Hacha name lav davka, deha shayyayr olat haof!
Bizvicha miha la shayyayr midde.
Vei baet ema: ha manni – rabbi elazar berabbi shimon hi, deamar: hay makom lechod, vehay makom lechod.

Detanya: damim hattachtonim nittanin michut hassikra ulematta, vehaelyonim michut hassikra ulemala. amar rabbi elazar berabbi shimon: bamme devarim amurin – beolat haof; aval bechattat behema – hi atzmah en naase ella al gufah shel keren.
Tenan hatam, shehaya rabbi akiva omer: kol damim shennichnesu lahechol lechapper – pesulim. vachachamim omrim: chattat bilvad. rabbi eliezer omer: af haasham, shenneemar: "kachattat kaasham".
Bishlama rabbi eliezer – kidkaamar tama, ella rabbanan may tama?
Amar rava: asham nichnas damo lifnim pasul – la matzet amrat, kal vachomer meola; ma

a: Ola shehi kalil, nichnas damah lifnim keshera; asham sheeno kalil, lo kol shekken?!
Ma leola, shekken enah mechapperet!
Minchat chote tochiach.
Velema: chattat haof tochiach! chattat haof – baya derabbi avin hi.
Velifroch: ma leminchat chote, shekken enah min zevach!

Ola tochiach. vechazar haddin; lo rei ze chiri ze, velo rei ze kiri ze; hatztzad hashshave shebbahen: shehen kodshe kadashim, venichnas (daman) lifnim – kesherin; af ani avi asham – shehu kodesh kodashim, venichnas damo lifnim – kasher.
Amar leh rava mibbarnish lerav ashe: velifroch, ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen – shekken en lahen kitzva; tomar beasham – sheyyesh lo kitzva?!
Ella hayeynu tamayyhu derabbanan, deamar kera: "damah" – damah shel zo, vela damah shel acher.
Veiddach – "damah" velo besarah.
Veiddach – "dam"–"damah".
Veiddach – "dam"–"damah" la daresh.
Bishlama lerabbanan, deamri: asham sheshshechato shello lishmo – kasher; hayeynu deittakkash mincha lechattat, mincha leasham.

Detanya, rabbi shimon omer: "kodesh kadashim hiv kachattat vechaasham" – minchat chote hare hi kechattat, lefichach kematzah shello lishmah, pesula; minchat nedava hare hi keasham, lefichach kematzah shello lishmah, keshera.
Ella lerabbi eliezer – lemay hilcheta ittakkash mincha lechattat umincha leasham?
Lechi iddach derabbi shimon, ditnan: shello bichle sharet – pesula. verabbi shimon machshir.
Veamar rav yehuda bereh derabbi chiyyay: may tama derabbi shimon? amar kera: "kodesh kodashim hiv kachattat ucheasham" – ba leovdah bayyad, ovdah bayyamin kachattat; bichli, ovdah bismol kaasham.
Verabbi shimon – hay kera mappek leh lehachi umappek leh lehachi?!
Ikkar kera – lechidrav yehuda bereh derabbi chiyyay hu daata; uminchat chote difsula shello lishmah [– tama acharina hu]: chattat tama may – dichtiv ba "hi"; minchat chote name ketiv ba "hi".
Ulerabbanan, lemay hilcheta ittakkash asham lechattat? lomar lach: ma chattat teuna semicha, af asham taun semicha.
Yosef ben choni omer: hannishchatin kulei. amar rabbi yochanan: yosef ben choni verabbi eliezer, amru davar echad.
Rabba amar: baacherim leshem chattat peligi.
Detanya: happesach sheibbera shenato, ushechato bizmanno lishmo; vechen hashshochet acherim leshem pesach bizmanno – rabbi eliezer posel, verabbi yehoshua machshir.
Amar rabbi yehoshua: im bishar yemot hashshana, sheeno kasher lishmo – acherim kesherim lishmo; bizmanno shehu kasher lishmo – eno din sheyyichsheru acherim lishmo?!

Amar lo rabbi eliezer, o chilluf haddevarim: uma im bishar yemot hashshana, sheeno kasher lishmo – kasher hu leshem acherim; bizmanno, shehu kasher lishmo – eno din sheyyucheshar leshem acherim?! veyucheshar pesach bearbaa asar shello lishmo!
Vechach atta omer?! ma li hucheshru acherim bishar yemot hashshana lishmo – shekken hu kasher leshem acherim; veyucheshru acherim bizmanno lishmo – shekken hu pasul leshem acherim?!
Amar lo rabbi yehoshua: im ken, horata koach pesach, venatatta koach bishlamim.
Chazar rabbi eliezer vedano din acher: matzinu motar pesach ba shelamim, veen motar shelamim ba pesach.
Uma pesach, shemmotaro ba shelamim – shechato bizmanno leshum shelamim, pasul; shelamim, sheen motaran ba pesach – im shechatam leshem pesach bizmanno, eno din sheyyehu pesulin?!
b: Amar lo rabbi yehoshua: matzinu motar chattat ba ola, veen motar ola ba chattat;
Uma chattat, shemmotarah ba ola – shechatah leshem ola, pesula; ola, sheen motarah ba chattat – shechatah leshem chattat, eno din shettehe pesula?!

Amar lo rabbi eliezer: lo; im amarta bechattat – shekken keshera lishmah kol hashshana kullah, tomar bappesach – sheeno kasher lishmo ella bizmanno?! hoil vehu pasul lishmo, din hu sheyyippaslu acherim lishmo.
Shimon achi azarya omer kulei.

Rav ashe matne mishshemeh derabbi yochanan, verav acha bereh derava matne mishshemeh derabbi yannay: may tama deshimon achi azarya? deamar kera: "velo yechallelu et kodshe bene yisrael et asher yarimu laAdonai" – bemuram mehen en mitchallelin, benamuch mehem mitchallelin.

Vehay lehachi hu daata?! veha mibbee leh lichdishmuel – deamar shemuel: minnayin laochel et hattevel shehu bemita? shenneemar: "velo yechallelu et kodshe bene yisrael et asher yarimu laAdonai" – baatidim litrom hakkatuv medabber.
Im ken, lichtov kera "asher huremu"; may "asher yarimu"? shema minnay tarte.
Bae rabbi zera: kesherin veen meratztzin – vechi pelig bachada pelig, o dilma kesherin umeratztzin – uvetarte peligi?
Amar abbaye, veittema rabbi zerika, ta shema: habbechor vehammaaser sheshshechatan leshem shelamim – kesherim. shelamim sheshshechatan leshem bechor o leshem maaser – pesulin.
Vei salka datach kesherin umeratztzin, bechor bar raytztzoye hu?! ella kesherin veen meratztzin! umiddesefa kesherin veen meratztzin, resha name kesherin veen meratztzin!
Midde irya?! ha kidita, veha kidita.
Ella may ka mashma lan? gavoah venamuch ka mashma lan?! tenena: ketzad? kodshe kadashim sheshshechatan leshem kodashim kallim kulei!
Mahu detema: kodshe kadashim vekadashim kallim hu deikka gavoah venamuch, aval kallim vekallim – la.
Ha name tenena: shelamim kodmim et habbechor, mippene shehen teunin mattan arba, usemicha, unesachim, utenufat chaze vashok!
Ha ikkar, hahi aggerara nasva.
Mishna happesach sheshshechato shacharit bearbaa asar shello lishmo – rabbi yehoshua machshir, keillu nishchat bishlosha asar. ben betira posel, keillu nishchat ben haarbayim.

Amar shimon ben azzay: mekubbal ani mippi shivim ushenayim zaken bayyom shehoshivu et rabbi eliezer bishiva, shekkol hazzevachim hanneechalin shennizbechu shello lishman – kesherin, ella shello alu labbealim mishshum chova; chutz min happesach umin hachattat. velo hosif ben azzay ella haola, velo hodu lo chachamim.
Gemara amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya: machshir haya ben betira befesach sheshshechato shacharit bearbaa asar lishmo, dechulleh yoma zimneh hu.
Umay "keillu"?
Ayyeyde deamar rabbi yehoshua "keillu", amar ihu name "keillu".
I hachi, addemippalgi beshello lishmo – lippalgu belishmo!
I ippeligu belishmo, hava amena: aval beshello lishmo – mode rabbi yehoshua leven betira, hoil umiktzato rauy; ka mashma lan.
Vehachtiv: "ben haarbayim"!
Amar ulla bereh derav illay: ben shene aravim.
Tamid, dichtiv beh: "ben haarbayim" – hachi name dechulle yoma kasher?!
Hatam, middichtiv: "et hakkeves echad taase vabboker", mikkelal deven haarbayim" – ben haarbayim mammash.
Ema chad babboker, iddach kulleh yoma!
"Echad... babboker" – velo shenayim babboker.
Nerot, dichtiv "ben haarbayim" – hachi name dechulle yoma kasher?!

Shane hatam, dichtiv: "meerev vead boker", vetanya: "meerev vead boker" – ten lah middatah shettehe doleket veholechet meerev vead boker. davar acher: en lecha avoda keshera meerev vead boker, ella zo bilvad.
Ketoret, dichtiv bah: "ben haarbayim" – hachi name dechulle yoma kasher?!
Shane ketoret,

a: Deittakkash lenerot.
Hatam name, ketiv: "sham tizbach et happesach baarev"!
Hahu liuchar davar" hu daata, detanya: yeuchar davar shenneemar bo "baarev" uven haarbayim", ledavar shello neemar bo ella "ben haarbayim" bilvad.
Umi ikka midde deillu shachet leh mitztzafra – amrat zimneh hu, vechi mate ben haarbayim – amrat "yeuchar davar"?
In; dehaamar rabbi yochanan: halacha – mitpallel shel mincha, veachar kach mitpallel shel musafin.
Uven haarbayim" dichtiv gabbe ketoret venerot, lema li?
Veod heshiv rabbi – tachat ben betira – ledivre rabbi yehoshua: lo; im amarta bishlosha asar – sheen miktzato rauy, tomar bearbaa asar – shemmiktzato rauy?!
Veim ita, kullo rauy hu!
Ella amar rabbi yochanan: posel haya ben betira befesach sheshshechato bearbaa asar shacharit, ben lishmo ben shello lishmo, hoil umiktzato rauy.
Megaddef ba rabbi avahu: im ken, pesach kasher leven betira – hechi mashkachat la? i deafresheh haiddana – dachuy meikkaro hu, vei deafreshinhu meetmol – nire venidche hu!
Ella amar rabbi avahu: tehe leachar chatzot.
Abbaye amar: afillu tema mitztzafra – en mechussar zeman levo bayyom.
Rav pappa amar: afillu tema meureta – layla en mechussar zeman; detane deve rabbi yishmael: lel shemini nichnas laddir lehitasser.
Vechidrabbi aftoriki, derabbi aftoriki rame: ketiv "vehaya shivat yamim tachat immo" – ha layla chaze; uchetiv "umiyyom hashshemini vahala yeratze" – ha layla la chaze!
Ha ketzad? layla likdushsha, veyom leharetzaa.
Amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi avahu: lema kasavar rabbi yochanan baale chayyim nidchin?!
Amar leh: in; deamar rabbi yochanan: behema shel shene shuttafin – hikdish chetzyah, vechazar velakach chetzyah vehikdishah – kedosha, veenah kereva.
Veose temura, utemuratah keyotze bah.
Ushema minna telat: shema minna baale chayyim nidchin, ushema minna dachuy meikkara have dachuy, ushema minna
b: Yesh dichuy bedamim.
Amar ulla amar rabbi yochanan: achal chelev vehifrish korban, venishtammed, vechazar bo – hoil venidcha, yiddache.
Ittemar name, amar rabbi yirmeya amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: achal chelev vehifrish korban, venishtatta, vechazar venishtappa – hoil venidcha, yiddache.
Utzerichi; dei ashmeinan kammayyta – mishshum dehu dache nafsheh beyadayim; aval hacha demimmela iddechi – keyashen dame.
Vei ashmeinan hacha – mishshum deen beyado lachazor; aval hacha deyesh beyado lachazor – ema la; tzericha.
Bae rabbi yirmeya: achal chelev vehifrish korban, vehoru bet din shechelev muttar, vechazru bahen, mahu? mi have dachuy, o la have dachuy?
Amar leh hahu sava: ki patach rabbi yochanan bidchuyin – meha patach. may tama? hatam – gavra iddechi, korban la iddechi; hacha – korban name iddechi.
Amar shimon ben azzay: mekubbelani mippi shivim ushenayim zaken kulei. lema li lemitna "shivim ushenayim zaken"? dechullehu bachada shitta havo kayymi.
Lo hosif ben azzay ella haola.
Amar rav huna: may tama deven azzay? "ola hu ishshe reach nichoach laAdonai" – hi lishmah keshera, shello lishmah pesula.
Asham name ketiv beh "hu"!
Hahu leachar haketarat emurim hu dichtiv.
Hay name leachar haketarat emurim hu dichtiv!
Tere "hu" ketivi.
Gabbe asham name tere "hu" ketivi!
Ella ben azzay bekal vachomer mayyte la: uma chattat sheenah kalil, shechatah shello lishmah – pesula, ola shehi kalil – lo kol shekken?!
Ma lechattat, shekken mechapperet!
Pesach yochiach.
Ma lefesach, shekken zemanno kavua!

Chattat tochiach. vechazar haddin; lo rei ze kiri ze, velo rei ze kiri ze; hatztzad hashshave shebbahen – shehen kodashim, ushechatan shello lishman pasul; af ani avi ola – shehi kadashim, ushechatah shello lishmah pesula.
Ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen, sheyyesh bahen tzad karet!
Ben azzay,

a: Tzad karet la parech.
Asham name layyte!
Asham – parech: ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen, shekken yeshnan betzibbur kivyachid.
Veibbaet ema: tzad karet name parech, uven azzay gemara gemir la. veha dekaamar rav huna kal vachomer – lo amarah ella lechadded bah talmidav.
Mishna happesach vehachattat sheshshechatan shello lishman, kibbel vehillech vezarak shello lishman; o lishman veshello lishman, o shello lishman velishman – pesulim.
Ketzad lishman veshello lishman? leshem pesach uleshem shelamim. shello lishman velishman? leshem shelamim uleshem pesach.
Shehazzevach nifsal bearbaa devarim: bishchita, uvekibbul, uvehilluch, uvizrika.
Rabbi shimon machshir behilluch, shehaya omer: i efshar shello bishchita veshello bekabbala veshello bizrika, aval efshar belo hilluch – shochet betzad hammizbeach vezorek.
Rabbi elyazar omer: hamehallech bimkom shehu tzarich lehallech – machshava poselet; bimkom sheeno tzarich lehallech – en machshava poselet.
Gemara vekabbala mi pasla?!

Vehatanya: "vehikrivu" – zo kabbalat haddam. atta omer kabbalat haddam, o eno ella zerika? keshehu omer "vezarku" – hare zerika amur; ha ma ani mekayyem "vehikrivu"? zo kabbalat haddam. "bene aharon hakkohanim" – shettehe bechohen kasher uvichli sharet.

Amar rabbi akiva: minnayin lekabbala shello tehe ella bechohen kasher uvichli sharet? neemar kan: "bene aharon", veneemar lehallan: "elle shemot bene aharon hakkohanim hammeshuchim"; ma lehallan – bechohen kasher uvichli sharet, af kan – bechohen kasher uvichli sharet.
Amar rabbi tarfon: akappeach et banayy, im lo shamati lehavechin hefresh ben kabbala lizrika. veen li lefaresh.

Amar rabbi akiva, ani afaresh: kabbala – lo asa bah machshava kemaase, zerika – asa bah machshava kemaase. kibbelo bachutz – eno chayyayv karet, zerako bachutz – anush karet. kibbeluhu pesulin – en chayyayvin alav, zerakuhu pesulin – chayyayvin alav.
Amar lo rabbi tarfon: haavoda im hitteta yamin usemol! ani shamati veen li lefaresh, atta doresh umaskim lashshemua! ballashon hazze amar lo: akiva, kol happoresh mimmecha keforesh mechayyav.
Amar rava: la kashya; kan bemachshevet piggul, kan bemachshevet shello lishmah.
Dayka name, dekatane "shehazzevach nifsal", vela katane "mitpaggel"; shema minna.
Umachshevet piggul la pasla bekabbala?!

Vehatanya: yachol lo tehe machshava moelet ella bizrika bilvad; minnayin lerabbot shechita vekabbala? talmud lomar: "veim heachol yeachel mibbesar zevach shelamav (piggul hu) bayyom hashshelishi lo yeratze" – bidvarim hammeviin lide achila hakkatuv medabber.
Yachol sheani merabbe af shefichat shirayim vehaketarat emurin?

Talmud lomar: "bayyom hashshelishi lo yeratze, hammakriv oto lo yechashev" – zerika bakkelal hayta, velamma yatzta? lehakkish eleha. lomar lecha: ma zerika meyuchedet – shehi avoda (umechapperet), umeakkevet kappara; af kol – avoda, umeakkevet kappara. yatzu shefichat shirayim vehaketarat emurin – sheen meakkevin et hakkappara.
b: Ella la kashya; ha deamar: "hareni shochet al menat lekabbel damah lemachar", ha deamar: "hareni mekabbel damah al menat lishpoch shirayim lemachar".
Amar leh hahu merabbanan lerava: ushefichat shirayim vehaketarat emurin – la pasla behu machshava?!

Vehatnan: yachol lo tehe machshava moelet ella baachilat basar, minnayin lerabbot shefichat shirayim vehaketarat emurim? talmud lomar: "veim heachol yeachel" – bishte achilot hakkatuv medabber: achat achilat adam, veachat achilat mizbeach.
La kashya; ha deamar: "hareni zorek al menat lishpoch shirayim lemachar", ha deamar: "hareni shofech shirayim al menat lehaketir emurin lemachar".
Amar rabbi yehuda bereh derabbi chiyyay: shamati shettevilat etzba mefaggelet bechattat penimit.
Shama ilfa, amra kammeh derav peda. amar: kelum lamadnu piggul – ella mishshelamim; ma shelamim – en tevilat etzba mefaggelet bahen, af chattat – en tevilat etzba mefaggelet (bahen) [bah].
Vechi hakkol mishshelamim lamdu?! i, ma shelamim – shello lishman en motzi mide piggul, af chattat – shello lishmah en motzi mide piggul!
Ella may it lach lememar – meribbuya dikrae kaatya; hacha name, meribbuya dikra kaate.

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: baaliyya zo shamati, shettevilat etzba mefaggelet. tahe ba rabbi shimon ben lakish: kelum lamdu piggul – ella mishshelamim; ma shelamim – en tevilat etzba mefaggelet bahen, af chattat – en tevilat etzba mefaggelet (bahen) [bah]!
Vechi hakkol mishshelamim lamdu?! i, ma shelamim – shello lishman en motzi mide piggul, af chattat – shello lishmah en motzi mide piggul!

Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: in, hakkol mishshelamim lamdu. hoil vechutz limkomo posel bishlamim, veshello lishmo posel bechattat; ma chutz limkomo happosel bishlamim – motzi mide piggul, af shello lishmo happosel bechattat – motziah mide piggul.
Amar rabbi yirmeya: mitztzidda tevara! ma lechutz limkomo happosel bishlamim – shekken noheg bechol hazzevachim; tomar beshello lishmo – sheeno noheg ella befesach vechattat bilvad?!
Ella may it lach lememar – davar happosel bahen motziam mide piggul, davar hameakkev bahen mevian lide piggul;
Hacha name – davar happosel bah motzi mide piggul, davar hameakkev bah mevia lide piggul.
Amar rav mari: af anan name tenena – ze hakkelal: kol hakkometz, venoten bichli, vehammolich, vehammaktir.
Bishlama kometz – hayeynu shochet; molich – hayeynu molich; maktir name – hayeynu zorek; ella noten bichli may nihu?
Illema dedame lekabbala – mi dame?! hatam mimmela, hacha ihu ka shakel verame!
Ella kevan dela saggi dela yahev – al karcheh avoda chashuva hi; hacha name, kevan dela saggi dela aved la – al karcheh hayeynu holacha.
La, leolam dedame lekabbala; udekaamrat: hacha mimmela, hatam ihu ka shakel veyahev – kevan deidde veidde mattan keli hu, ma li mimmela ma li ka shakel veyahev.
Lema ketannae – detane chada: tevilat etzba mefaggelet bechattat, vetanya iddach: lo mefaggelet velo mitpaggelet; may, lav tannae hi?
La; ha rabbanan, ha rabbi shimon.
I rabbi shimon, may irya tevilat etzba? haamar:

a: Kol sheeno al mizbeach hachitzon kishlamim – en bo mishshum piggul!
Ella ha veha rabbanan, vela kashya; kan bechattaot hachitzonot, kan bechattaot happenimiyyot.
Chattaot hachitzonot – peshita, la ketiv behu "vetaval"!
Itzterich; salka datach amena: hoil uchetiv "velakach" – vei ate kof rame lehu ayyedeh bae lemishkal zimna achariti – keman dichtiv "vetaval" dame;
Ka mashma lan: lehachi la ketiv "vetaval" – demashma hachi umashma hachi.
Rabbi shimon machshir behilluch. amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: mode rabbi shimon beholachat chattaot happenimiyyot shemmachshava poselet bah, hoil vaavoda sheen yachol levattelah.
Vehaamar rabbi shimon: kol sheeno al mizbeach hachitzon kishlamim, en chayyayvin alav mishshum piggul!
Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: mode haya lifsol mikkal vachomer – uma shello lishman, shehucheshru bishlamim – pasul bechattat; chutz lizmanno, shepposel bishlamim – eno din sheyyifsol bechattaot?
Veashkechan chutz lizmanno, chutz limkomo menalan?
I michutz lizmanno – ma lechutz lizmanno, shekken karet!
I mishshello lishmah – shekken noheg bevama!
(Chiyyuv) shello lishman bemay noheg – befesach vechattat; pesach vechattat bevama lo karvu.
Veibbaet ema: hekkesha hu; "shelishi" – ze chutz lizmanno, "piggul" – ze chutz limkomo.
Amar rava: im timtze lomar rabbi shimon savar la kivreh, deamar: ben haulam velammizbeach – tzafon; en machshava moelet beholachat chattaot happenimiyyot, ella mippetach ulam velifnim.
Veim timtze lomar savar la kerabbi yehuda, deamar: toch azara mekaddesh; en machshava moelet beholachat silluk bazichin, ella mippetach hechol velachutz.
Veim timtze lomar, savar: kedushshat hechol veulam – chada hi; en machshava moelet ella mippetach ulam velachutz.
Veim timtze lomar toch happetach kelifnim; en machshava moelet afillu pesia achat, ella bichde hoshatat yado.
Veim timtze lomar, savar: holacha shello baregel – lo shemah holacha; en machshava moelet kelal.
Amar leh abbaye leamoreh derav chisda, bei minneh merav chisda: holacha bezar – mahu?
Amar leh: keshera, umikra mesayyeyeni – "vayyishchatu et happesach, vayyizreku hakkohanim et haddam miyyadam, vehaleviyyim mafshitim".
Metiv rav sheshet: zar, veonen,
b: Shikkor, uvaal mum; bekabbala beholacha bizrika – pasul. vechen yoshev, vechen semol! teyuveta.
Veha rav chisda kera kaamar!
Deaved maase itzteva.
Rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu: holacha bezar – machloket rabbi shimon verabbanan; rabbi shimon deamar: avoda sheefshar levattelah, lav avoda hi – keshera bezar. lerabbanan – pesula.
Amar leh abbaye: veha shechita, daavoda shei efshar levattelah – ucheshera bezar! amar leh: shechita lav avoda hi.
Vela?! vehaamar rabbi zera amar rav: shechitat para bezar – pesula; veamar rav ala: "elazar" vechukka" ketiv ba!
Shane para, dekodshe bedek habbayit hi.
Velav kol dechen hu – kodshe bedek habbayit havya avoda, kodshe mizbeach lav avoda hi?!
Amar rav shisha bereh derav idi: midde dehave ammarot negaim; delav avoda hi, uvaaya kehunna.
Vahare holachat evarim lakkevesh, daavoda sheefshar levattelah hi – ufesula bezar; dichtiv: "vehikriv hakkohen et hakkol vehiktir hammizbecha" – veamar mar: zo holachat evarim lakkevesh!
Hecha degalli galli, vehecha dela galli la galli.
Velav kol dechen hu? uma holachat evarim lakkevesh, dela meakkeva kappara – baaya kehunna; holachat dam, dimakkeva kappara – [lo kol shekken] (mibbaya)?!
Ittemar name, amar ulla amar rabbi elazar: holacha bezar pesula, afillu lerabbi shimon.
Ibbaya lehu: holacha shello baregel, shemah holacha o lo shemah holacha?
Ta shema: vechen yoshev, vechen semol – pasul; ha omed dumeya deyoshev – kasher!
Dilma yoshev – dekashayef meshaf, omed dumeya deyoshev – denayed pureta.
Ta shema: shachat yisrael vekibbel hakkohen, netano lachavero, vachavero lachavero!
Hatam name denayydi pureta. umay ka mashma lan? "berov am haderat melech".
Ta shema: kibbel hakkasher venatan lappasul – yachzir lakkasher!
Ema: yachzor hakkasher vikabbelah.
Ittemar, amar ulla amar rabbi yochanan: holacha shello baregel – lo shemah holacha.

a: Efshar letakkona o la efshar letakkona?
Ta shema: kibbel hakkasher venatan lappasul – yachzir lakkasher;
Unehi name deyachzor hakkasher vikabbelennu, i salka datach la efshar letakkona – ippesala la!
Mi savrat dekae zar gavvay?! la; dekae zar baray.
Ittemar, amar ulla amar rabbi yochanan: holacha shello baregel – pesula. alma la efshar letakkona.
Etiveh rav nachman leulla: nishpach min hakkeli al haritzpa vaasafo – kasher!
Hacha bemay askinan – kesheyyatza lachutz.
Levaray nafek legavvay la ayel?! bimkom midron. ibbaet ema: begumma. veibbaet ema: bismicha.

Veikkefal tanna leashmoinan kol hane?! veod, addetane beiddach pirkin: nishpach al haritzpa vaasafo – pasul; liflog bedideh: bamme devarim amurim – kesheyyatza lachutz, aval nichnas lifnim – pasul! teyuveta.
Ittemar: holacha shello baregel – machloket rabbi shimon verabbanan. beholacha rabbati – dechulle alma la peligi difsula, ki peligi – beholacha zutarti.

Machachu ala bemareva: ella chattat haof, difsula bah machshava – lerabbi shimon hechi mashkachat la? i dechashshev ala mikkamme delippok dam – la kelum hi; vei batar dinfak dam – itavida leh mitzvato!
May kusheya? dilma middefaresh vead dimta lemizbeach –
Deha bea minneh rabbi yirmeya merabbi zera: haya mazze, veniktea yado shel mazze ad shello higgia dam laavir hammizbeach, mahu? vaamar leh: pesula. may tama? "vehizza... venatan" baenan.
Ki ato rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua mibbe rav, amri, hayeynu chucha: uveholacha rabbati la peligi?! veha ki peligi – beholacha rabbati peligi!
Ella beholacha zutarti – kulle alma la peligi dela pasla; ki peligi – beholacha rabbati.
Holicho zar, vehechziro kohen vechazar veholicho – peligi ba bene rabbi chiyyay verabbi yannay; chad amar kasher, vechad amar pasul. mar savar: efshar letakkona, umar savar: la efshar letakkona.
Holicho kohen vehechziro, vechazar veholicho zar – amar rav shimi bar ashe: ledivre hammachshir – pasul, ledivre happosel – machshir.
Rava amar: af ledivre happosel pasul; may tama? deha tzarich
b: Leamtoyeh.
Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerav ashe, hachi amar rav yirmeya middifti: "ha tzarich leamtoyeh" – machloket rabbi elyazar verabbanan.
Ditnan, rabbi elyazar omer: hamehallech bemakom shetztzarich lehallech – machshava poselet. makom sheen tzarich lehallech – en machshava poselet.
Veamar rava, hakkol modim: kibbelo bachutz vehichniso bifnim – zehu hilluch shetztzarich lehallech. kibbelo bifnim vehotzio lachutz – zehu hilluch sheen tzarich lehallech.
Lo nechleku ella keshehichniso vechazar vehotzio; mar savar: ha tzarich leamtoyeh, umar savar: lav kehilluch hatztzarich laavoda dame.

Etiveh abbaye, rabbi elyazar omer: hamehallech makom shetztzarich lehallech – machshava poselet. ketzad? kibbelo bachutz vehichniso lifnim – zehu hilluch shetztzarich lehallech. kibbelo bifnim vehotzio lachutz – zehu hilluch sheen tzarich lelech. veha chazar vehichniso – hilluch shetztzarich lehallech hu!
Amar leh: i tanya, tanya.
Hadaran alach kol hazzevachim

Mishna kol hazzevachim shekkibbelu daman zar, onen, tevul yom, umechussar kippurim, umechussar begadim, shello rachatz yadayim veraglayim, arel, tame, yoshev, omed al gabbe kelim, al gabbe behema, al gabbe ragle chavero – pasal.
Kibbel bismol – pasal. rabbi shimon machshir.
Gemara zar menalan? detane levi: "dabber el aharon veel banav lemor, veyinnazru mikkodshe bene yisrael vegomer" – "bene yisrael" lemaote may? illema lemaote nashim – korban nashim betumea karev?!
Ella lemaote goyim? hasheta tzitz la meratztze, deamar mar: uvaggoyim – ben beshogeg ben bemezid lo huretza; betumea karev?!
Ella hachi kaamar: "veyinnazru mikkodshe, vene yisrael velo yechallelu".
Deve rabbi yishmael tana, atya bekal vachomer mibbaal mum: ma baal mum, sheochel – im avad chillel;

a: Zar, sheeno ochel – eno din sheim avad chillel?!
Ma levaal mum – shekken asa bo karev kemakriv!
Tame yochiach. ma letame – shekken metamme!
Baal mum yochiach. vechazar haddin. lo rei ze kiri ze, velo rei ze kiri ze; hatztzad hashshave shebbahen – shemmuzeharin, veim avdu chillelu; af ani avi zar – shehu muzehar, veim avad chillel.
Menalan demuzehar? i mivveyinnazru" – chillul begufeh ketiv beh! ella mivvezar lo yikrav alechem" –
Ikka lemifrach: ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen, shekken lo hutteru bevama!
La tema: tame yochiach, ella ema: onen yochiach. ma leonen – shekken asur bammaaser! [baal mum] yochiach.
Vechazar haddin, lo rei ze kiri ze, hatztzad hashshave shebbahen shemmuzeharin kulei.
Hacha name lifroch: ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen – shekken lo hutteru bevama! matkef la rav samma bereh derava: uman lema lan deonen asur bevama? dilma shere bevama!
Rav mesharsheya amar, atya kal vachomer miyyoshev: ma yoshev, sheochel – im avad chillel; zar, sheeno ochel – eno din sheim avad chillel?!
Ma leyoshev – shekken pasul leedut! miyyoshev talmid chacham.
Ma leshem yoshev – shekken pasul leedut! shem yoshev la parech. veim timtza lomar parech – atya miyyoshev umechada mehanach.
Veyoshev dechasher bevama – menalan? amar kera: "laamod lifne Adonai lesharto" – lifne Adonai velo lifne bama.
Onen menalan? dichtiv: "umin hammikdash lo yetze, velo yechallel" – ha acher shello yatza, chillel.
Rabbi elazar amar mehacha: "hen hikrivu" – ani hikravti, mikkelal dei inhu akriv – shappir isteruf.
Verabbi elazar – may tama la amar miumin hammikdash lo yetze"? amar lach, mi ketiv: ha acher shello yatza – chillel?!
Veiddach – may tama la amar mehen hikrivu"? kasavar: mippene tumea nisrefa.
Deve rabbi yishmael tana: atya bekal vachomer mibbaal mum; uma
b: Baal mum, sheochel – im avad chillel; onen, sheen ochel – eno din sheim avad chillel?!
Ma levaal mum, shekken asa bo kerevin kemakrivin!
Zar yochiach. ma lezar, shekken en lo takkana!
Baal mum yochiach. vechazar haddin. lo rei ze chiri ze, velo rei ze kiri ze; hatztzad hashshave shebbahen – shehen muzeharin, veim avdu chillelu; af ani avi onen – shemmuzehar, veim avad chillel.
Hechan muzehar? illema miumin hammikdash lo yetze", chillul begufeh ketiv beh! ella mehen hikrivu" – vekasavar mippene aninut nisrefa.
Ikka lemifrach: ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen, shekken lo huttera mikkelalo!
Tame yochiach.
Ma letame, shekken metamme! hanach yochichu. vechazar haddin kulei, hatztzad hashshave shebbahen shemmuzeharin kulei.
Velifroch: ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen – shekken lo hutteru mikkelalan etzel kohen gadol bekorban yachid! shem tumea miha ishteray.
Rav mesharsheya amar: atya bekal vachomer miyyoshev; uma yoshev, sheochel – im avad chillel; onen, sheeno ochel – eno din sheim avad chillel?!
Ma leyoshev, shekken pasul leedut! miyyoshev talmid chacham.
Ma leshem yoshev, shekken pasul leedut! shem yoshev la parech. veim timtze lomar parech – atya miyyoshev umechada mehanach.
Onen pasul. amar rava: lo shanu ella bekorban yachid, aval bekorban tzibbur – meratztze, kal vachomer mittumea;

Ma tumea, shello huttera mikkelalah etzel kohen gadol bekorban yachid – huttera etzel hedyot bekorban tzibbur; aninut, shehuttera mikkelalah etzel kohen gadol bekarban yachid – eno din shehuttera etzel kohen hedyot bekorban tzibbur?!

Matkef la rava bar ahilay: lo tuttar aninut etzel kohen gadol bekorban yachid, mikkal vechomer: uma tumea, shehuttera etzel kohen hedyot betzibbur – lo huttera etzel kohen gadol bekorban yachid; aninut, shello huttera etzel kohen hedyot bekorban tzibbur – eno din shello tuttar etzel kohen gadol bekorban yachid?!

Vetuttar tumea etzel kohen gadol bekorban yachid, mikkal vechomer: uma aninut, shello huttar etzel kohen hedyot bekorban tzibbur – huttera etzel kohen gadol bekorban yachid; tumea, shehuttera etzel kohen hedyot bekorban tzibbur – eno din shehuttera etzel kohen gadol bekorban yachid?!

Velo tuttar tumea etzel kohen hedyot bekorban tzibbur, mikkal vechomer: uma aninut, shehuttera etzel kohen gadol bekorban yachid – lo huttera etzel kohen hedyot bekorban tzibbur; tumea, shello huttera etzel kohen gadol bekarban yachid – eno din shello tuttar bechohen hedyot bekorban tzibbur?!
(Velo tuttar, velo tuttar, aninut, vetumea, tumea, yachid, veyachid, tzibbur – siman)

a: Ella ikka lemifrach hachi veikka lemifrach hachi, kol chada vachada teku beducheteh.
Tevul yom menalan? detanya, rabbi simay omer: remez litvul yom sheim avad chillel – minnayin? talmud lomar: "kedoshim yihyu velo yechallelu";
Im eno inyan letame – denafek mivveyinnazru", tenehu inyan litvul yom.
Ema: tenehu inyan lekoreach korcha, ulemashchit peat zakan!
Tevul yom deim avad – bemita, mena lan? degamar "chillul"–"chillul" mitteruma; defasel bitruma – machel avoda, dela pasel bitruma – la machel avoda.
Amar rabba: lema li dichtav rachamana tame, utevul yom, umechussar kippurim?
Tzerichi; dei ketav rachamana tame – shekken metamme. bitvul yom; mechussar kippurim la ate minneh – shekken pasul bitruma. bimchussar kippurim; tevul yom la ate minneh – shekken mechussar maase.
Mechada la ate; tete chada mittarte!
Behe la lichtov rachamana? la lichtov bimchussar kippurim vetete mehanach – ma lehanach, shekken pesulim bitruma.
Ella la lichtov rachamana bitvul yom, vetete mehanach; demay parchat – ma lehanach shekken mechussarim maase? sof sof kelisha la tumeatan.
b: Kasavar mechussar kippurim dezav – kezav dame.

Umechussar kippurim dezav kezav dame – tannae hi; detanya: serafah onen umechussar kippurim – keshera. yosef habbavli omer: onen – keshera, mechussar kippurim – pesula. may, lav beha kamippalgi – mar savar: mechussar kippurim dezav kezav dame, umar savar: lav kezav dame?
La, dechulle alma – kezav dame; vehacha beha kamippalgi, dichtiv: "vehizza hattahor" – mikkelal shehu tame; limmed al tevul yom shekkasher bappara.
Mar savar: tumea dechol hattora kullah, umar savar: tumea dehach parasha.
Hilkach, onen utevul yom ditme sheretz – dekili, atu bekal vachomer mittevul yom demet; aval mechussar kippurim dezav – dachamir, shekken tumea yotza alav miggufo; la.

Mechussar begadim menalan? amar rabbi avu amar rabbi yochanan, umatu bah mishshemeh derabbi elazar berabbi shimon, deamar kera: "vechagarta otam avnet aharon uvanav, vechavashta lahem migbaot, vehayta lahem kehunna lechukkat olam" – bizman shebbigdehem alehem, kehunnatam alehem; en bigdehem alehem, en kehunnatam alehem.

Veha – mehacha nafka?! mehatam nafka – detanya: minnayin lishtuye yayin sheim avad chillel? talmud lomar: "yayin veshechar al tesht vegomer, ulehavdil ben hakkodesh uven hachol". mechussar begadim veshello rachutz yadayim veraglayim, minnayin?

a: Talmud lomar: "chukka"–"chukka" ligzera shava.
I mehatam, hava amena: hane mille avoda dezar chayyayv aleha mita, aval avoda deen zar chayyayv aleha mita – ema la; ka mashma lan.
Ashkechan mechussar begadim, shetuye yayin menalan? atya "chukka"–"chukka" mimmechussar begadim.
Veha tanna "ulehavdil ben vegomer" ka nasev la! mikkamme delekum gezera shava.

Veha tanna mechussar begadim hu deka yalef mishshetuye yayin! hachi kaamar: minnayin shello nechleku ben mechussar begadim – lishtuye yayin veshello rachutz yadayim veraglayim? talmud lomar: "chukka"–"chukka" ligzera shava.
Ella "lehavedil" lema li? lechidrav – derav la mokem amora aleh miyyoma tava lechavreh, mishshum shichrut.
Akkatti mehacha nafka?! mehatam nafka: "venatnu bene aharon hakkohen" – bechihunno; limmed al kohen gadol shellavash bigde kohen hedyot veavad, avodato pesula!
I mehatam, hava amena: hane mille avoda dimakkeva kappara, aval avoda dela meakkeva kappara – la.

Veakkatti mehacha nafka?! mehatam nafka: "vearchu bene aharon hakkohanim et hannetachim vegomer" – "hakkohanim" bechihunan; mikkan lechohen hedyot shellavash bigde kohen gadol, veavad – avodato pesula!
I mehatam, hava amena: hane mille chissur, aval yittur – la; ka mashma lan.

Tanu rabbanan: hayu merushshalin, mesullakin, meshuchakim – veavad; avodato keshera. lavash shene michnasayim, shene avnetim, chaser achat, yater achat, o shehayta lo retiyya al makkat besaro tachat bigdo, o shehayu
b: Metushetashin o mekorain – veavad; avodato pesula.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: merushshalin – kesherin, mesullakin – pesulin. vehatanya mesullakin kesherin! amar rame bar chama: la kashya; kan shessilkan al yede avnet, kan deletnihu meikkara kelal.
Rav amar: echad ze veechad ze – pesulin.

Rav huna ikkela leargiza, rema leh bar ushepizchaneh: mi amar shemuel merushshalin kesherin umesullakin pesulin?! vehatanya: mesullakin – kesherin! amar leh: bar minna dehahi, deshanneyay rame bar chama.
Ella lerav – kashya! vechi tema: may merushshalin – mesullakin al yede avnet, veavnet megaz agez; ella mesullakin kashya!
Amar rabbi zera, rav chada tane: merushshalin shessillekan al yede avnet – kesherin.

Amar rabbi yirmeya middifti: merushshalin shello sillekan – tannae hi, detanya: "al arba kanfot kesutecha" – arba velo shalosh. o eno ella arba velo chamesh? keshehu omer "asher techasse bah" – hare baalat chamesh amur; ha ma ani mekayyem arba? arba velo shalosh. uma raita lerabbot baalat chamesh ulehotzi baalat shalosh? merabbe ani baalat chamesh – sheyyesh bichlal chamesh arba, umotzi ani baalat shalosh – sheen bichlal shalosh arba.
Vetanya iddach: "al arba kanfot kesutecha" – arba velo shalosh, arba velo chamesh. may, lav beha kamippalgi – demar savar: yater keman deiteh dame, umar savar: keman deleteh dame?
La, dechulle alma keman deiteh dame; veshane hacha, derabbi rachamana: "asher techasse bah".

Veiddach, hay "asher techasse bah" may aved leh? mibbee leh lechidtanya: "ureitem oto" – perat lichsut layla. o eno ella perat lichsut some? keshehu omer: "asher techasse bah" – hare kesut some amur, ha ma ani mekayyem "ureitem oto"? perat lichsut layla.
Uma raita lerabbot kesut some ulehotzi kesut layla? merabbe ani kesut some – sheyyeshnah biriyya etzel acherim, umotzi ani kesut layla – sheenah biriyya etzel acherim.
Veiddach – nafka leh measher". veiddach – "asher" la daresh.
Tanu rabbanan: bad – sheyyihyu shel butz; "bad" – sheyyehu chadashim; "bad" – sheyyehu shezurim; "bad" – sheyyehu chutan kaful shishsha; "bad" – shello yilbash shel chol immahen.

Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: bishlama sheyyehu shel butz – ha ka mashma lan: butz in, midde acharina la. ella "bad" sheyyehu chadashim – chadashim in, shechakin la?! vehatanya: meshuchakin – kesherim!

Amar leh: velitamaych, "bad" – sheyyehu chutan kaful shishsha?! "bad" – chad chad lechodeh mashma! ella hachi kaamar: begadim shenneemar bahen "bad" – tzerichin sheyyehu shel butz, chadashim, shezurin, sheyyehe chutan kaful shishsha; yesh mehen lemitzva, yesh mehen leakkev.
Mimmay dehay "bad" – kittana hu? amar rabbi yosef berabbi chanina: davar haole min hakkarka bad bevad.
Ema amra! amra mippetzel. kittana name mippetzel! al yede lakuta mippetzel.
Ravina amar mehacha: "paare fishtim yihyu al rosham, umichnese fishtim yihyu al motnehem, lo yachgeru bayyaza".

Amar leh rav ashe leravina: veha ad daata yechezkel – menalan? uletamaych, ha deamar rav chisda: davar ze – mittorat moshe rabbenu lo lamadnu, middivre yechezkel ben buzi lamadnu: "kol ben nechar erel lev veerel basar lo yavo el mikdashi lesharteni"; ad shebba yechezkel menalan? ella gemara gemiri la – vaata yechezkel veasmecheh akkera; hacha name gemara gemiri la kulei.
May "lo yachgeru bayyaza"? amar abbaye: la yachgeru bimkom shemmeziin. kidtanya: keshehem chogrin, en chogrin lo lematta mimmotnehen, velo lemala meatztzilehen, ella

a: Keneged atztzile yedehen.

Amar rav ashe, amar li huna bar natan: zimna chada hava kaemna kammeh deizgaddar malka vahava middele li hemyaynay, vetayteyeh nihaleh, vaamar li: "mamlechet kohanim vegoy kadosh" ketiv bechu. ki atay kammeh deammemar, amar li: ikkayyaym becha "vehayu melachim omnayich".
Tenan hatam: kohen shellaka beetzbao – korech aleha gemi bemikdash, aval lo bammedina. veim lehotzi mimmenna dam – kan vechan asur.
