Amar rabbi yehuda bereh derabbi chiyyay: lo shanu ella gemi, aval tziltzol katan – have yittur begadim. verabbi yochanan amar: lo amru yittur begadim ella bimkom begadim, aval shello bimkom begadim – la have yittur.
Vetippok leh mishshum chatzitza! bismol. i name, shello bimkom avoda.
Ufeliga derava – deamar rava amar rav chisda: bimkom begadim – afillu nima achat chotzetzet. shello bimkom begadim – shalosh al shalosh chotztzot, pachot mikkan enan chotztzot.
Adderabbi yochanan – vadday peliga; adderabbi yehuda bereh derabbi chiyyay mi lema difliga?
Shane tziltzol katan, dachashiv.

Lishshana acharina amri la, amar rabbi yehuda bereh derabbi chiyyay: lo shanu ella gemi, aval tziltzol katan – chotzetz. verabbi yochanan amar: lo amru chatzitza befachot mishshalosh al shalosh – ella bimkom begadim, aval shello bimkom begadim – shalosh al shalosh chotztzot, pachot mikken enah chotzetzet. vehayeynu derava amar rav chisda.
Lema peliga adderabbi yehuda bereh derabbi chiyyay? shane tziltzol katan, dachashiv.
Ulerabbi yochanan – may irya gemi? lashmeinan tziltzol katan! milleta aggav orcheh ka mashma lan, degemi masse.
Bae rava: nichnesa lo ruach bevigdo, mahu? "al besaro" baenan – veha lekka; o dilma derech levisha bechach?
Kinna – mahu shettachotz?
Meta la tibbee lach, devadday chayytza; chayya may? mi amrinan: kevan (deata) [deatya] veazla – revita hi vela chayytza; o dilma, kevan dekafed ala – chayytza?
Afar – mahu sheyyachotz? afar vadday chayetz! ella avak afar mahu?
Bet hashshechi – mahu sheyyachotz? "al besaro" baenan – veha lekka; o dilma derech levisha bechach?
Hichnis yado letoch cheko, mahu? gufo mi chayetz, o la?
Nima – mahu shettachotz? nima vadday chayytza! ella nima meduledelet mahu?
Bae mar bar rav ashe: yatza searo bevigdo, mahu? searo kegufo dame, o lav kegufo dame?

Bae rabbi zera: tefillin – mahu sheyyachotztzu? allibba deman deamar layla lav zeman tefillin hu – la tive lach; kevan delayla chayytzi, yom name chayytzi. ki tibbee lach – leman deamar layla zeman tefillin; may? mitzva degufeh – chayetz o la chayetz?
Iggalgal milleta, umeta lekammeh derabbi amme. amar leh: talmud aruch hu beyadenu: tefillin chotztzot.
Metivi: kohanim baavodatan vlviyyim beduchanan veyisrael bemaamadan – peturin min hattefilla umin hattefillin. may, lav im hinnichan enan chotztzot? la, im hinnichan chotztzot.
I hachi, "peturim"?! "asurim" mibbee leh! kevan deikka leviyyim veyisrael – dela matnu leh "asur", mishshum hachi tena "peturin".
Vehatanya: im hinnichan enan chotztzot! la kashya; ha deyad, ha derosh.
May shena deyad, dichtiv: "yilbash al besaro" – shello yehe davar chotzetz beno livsaro; derosh name, ketiv: "vesamta hammitznefet al rosho"!
Tana: searo haya nire ben tzitz lemitznefet,
b: Sheshsham mannichin tefillin.
Mechussar kippurim menalan? amar rav huna, amar kera: "vechipper aleha hakkohen vetahera" – "tahera" mikkelal shehi temea.
Veshello rachutz yadayim veraglayim. atya "chukka"–"chukka" mimmechussar begadim.

Tanu rabbanan: kohen gadol shello taval veshello kiddesh ben beged leveged uven avoda laavoda, veavad – avodato keshera. veechad kohen gadol veechad kohen hedyot shello kiddesh yadav veraglav shacharit, veavad – avodato pesula.
Amar leh rav assi lerabbi yochanan: mikkedi chamesh tevilot vaasara kiddushin deorayyta, vechukka" ketiv behu – liakkevu!
Amar leh, amar kera: "ulevesham" – levisha meakkevet, veen davar acher meakkev.
Tzahavu panav, amar leh: vav aufeta ketavi lach – i hachi, detzafra name.
Amar chizkiyya, amar kera: "vehayta lahem chok olam lo ulezaro ledorotam" – davar hameakkev bezaro, meakkev bo; davar sheeno meakkev bezaro, en meakkev bo.
Rabbi yonatan amar mehacha: "verachatzu mimmennu moshe veaharon uvanav" – davar hameakkev bevanav meakkev bo, davar sheeno meakkev bevanav en meakkev bo.
Rabbi yonatan may tama la amar middechizkiyya? amar lach: hahu ledorot hu dichtiv.

Veiddach – may tama la amar mehay? mibbee leh lechidrabbi yose berabbi chanina – deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: kol kiyyor sheen bo kede lekaddesh arbaa kohanim mimmennu – en mekaddeshin bo, shenneemar: "verachatzu mimmennu moshe veaharon uvanav".

Tanu rabbanan: ketzad mitzvat kiddush? manniach yado hayemanit al gabbe raglo hayemanit, veyado hassemalit al gabbe raglo hassemalit, umekaddesh. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: manniach shete yadav zo al gav zo, veal gabbe shete raglav zo al gabbe zo, umekaddesh. amru lo: hiflagta, i efshar laasot ken.
Shappir kaamri leh! amar rav yosef: vachavero mesayyeyo.
May benayyhu? amar abbaye: amida min hatztzad ikka benayyhu.
Amar leh rav samma bereh derav ashe leravina: velittev mittav ulekaddesh! amar kera: "lesharet" – vesherut meummad hu.

Tanu rabbanan: kiddesh yadav veraglav bayyom – en tzarich lekaddesh ballayla, ballayla – tzarich lekaddesh bayyom, divre rabbi; shehaya rabbi omer: lina moelet bekiddush yadayim veraglayim. rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: en lina moelet bekiddush yadayim veraglayim.

Tanya iddach: haya omed umakriv al gabbe mizbeach kol hallayla laora – taun kiddush yadayim veraglayim. divre rabbi. rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: kevan shekkiddesh yadav veraglav mittechillat avoda – afillu mikkan vead asara yamim eno tzarich lekaddesh.

Utzericha; dei ashmeinan kammayyta – behahi kaamar rabbi, difsak leh meavoda laavoda; aval beha, dela pesak leh – ema mode leh rabbi lerabbi elazar berabbi shimon. vei ashmeinan beha – beha kaamar rabbi elazar berabbi shimon; aval beha – ema mode leh lerabbi; tzericha.
May tama derabbi? dichtiv: "begishtam". may tama derabbi elazar berabbi shimon? dichtiv: "bevoam".
Veiddach name, ha ketiv "bevoam"! i ketiv "begishtam" vela ketiv "bevoam" – hava amena: al kol gisha vegisha; ketav rachamana: "bevoam".
Veiddach name, ha ketiv "begishtam"! i ketiv "bevoam" vela ketiv "begishtam" – hava amena: afillu abbia rekanit.

Abbia rekanit?! ha ketiv: "lesharet"! ella begishtam mibbee leh, lechidrav acha bar yaakov. deamar rav acha bar yaakov: hakkol modim bekiddush sheni – keshehu lavush mekaddesh; deamar kera: "o vegishtam" – mi sheeno mechussar ella gisha bilvad, yatza ze shemchussar levisha vegisha.
"Lehaketir ishshe" lema li?

a: Mahu detema: hane mille – avoda dimakkeva kappara, aval avoda dela meakkeva kappara – la; ka mashma lan.

Ki ata rav dimi, amar rabbi yochanan: bae ilfa, ledivre haomer en lina moelet bekiddush yadayim veraglayim – me chiyyor mahu sheyyippaslu? mi amrinan: hane lemay – lekiddush yadayim veraglayim, kiddush yadayim veraglayim gufayyhu la pasel behu lina; o dilma, kevan dikdush lehu bichle sharet – mippasli?
Ki ata ravin amar rabbi yirmeya amar rabbi amme amar rabbi yochanan, hadar pashet ilfa: kemachloket bazo kach machloket bazo.

Amar lefanav rabbi yitzchak bar bisna: rabbi, atta omer ken?! ella hachi amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan [mishshemeh deilfa]: kiyyor shello shikkeo mibbaerev – mekaddesh mimmennu laavodat layla, ulemachar eno mekaddesh.
Vehavenan ba: lemachar eno mekaddesh – dela tzerich lekaddoshe; o dilma, ippesalu belina? vela peshit lan, umar ka fashet leh mifshayt.
Ta shema: ben katin asa shenem asar dad lakkiyyor, af hu asa mucheni lakkiyyor shello yihyu memav nifsalin belina. may, lav rabbi elazar berabbi shimon hi? la, rabbi hi.
Veha midderesha rabbi elazar berabbi shimon – sefa name rabbi elazar berabbi shimon!

Dekatane resha: ba lo etzel paro; ufar haya omed ben haulam ulemizbeach, rosho laddarom ufanav lammaarav; vehakkohen omed bammizrach ufanav lammaarav. man shamat leh deamar ben haulam velammizbeach – tzafon? rabbi elazar berabbi shimon!

Detanya: ezehu tzafon? mikkir mizbeach tzefoni vead kotel azara tzefoni, ucheneged kol hammizbeach kullo tzafon. divre rabbi yose berabbi yehuda. rabbi elazar berabbi shimon mosif: af ben haulam velammizbeach. rabbi mosif: af mekom derisat ragle hakkohanim umekom derisat ragle yisrael. aval min hachalifot velifnim – hakkol modim sheppasul.
Vetisbera?! rabbi elazar berabbi shimon hi – vela rabbi?! [hasheta rabbi] adderabbi yose berabbi yehuda mosef, adderabbi elazar berabbi shimon la mosef?!
Anan hachi kaamrinan: i salka datach rabbi hi, lokma bimkom derisat ragle chohanim uvimkom derisat ragle yisrael.

Ella may, rabbi elazar berabbi shimon hi?! lokma mikkir mizbeach tzefoni ad kotel azara tzefoni! ella may it lach lememar – mishshum chulesha dechohen gadol; hacha name, mishshum chulesha dechohen gadol.
Amar rabbi yochanan: kiddesh yadav veraglav litrumat haddeshen – lemachar eno tzarich lekaddesh, shekkevar kiddesh mittechillat avoda.
Leman? i lerabbi, haamar: pasla lina! i lerabbi elazar berabbi shimon, haamar: en tzarich lekaddesh afillu mikkan vead asara yamim!
Amar abbaye: leolam lerabbi; velina – derabbanan hi, umode demikkerot haggever vead tzafra la pasla lina.
Rava amar: leolam rabbi elazar berabbi shimon [hi, veraa rabbi yochanan devarav] bitchillat avoda, velo besof avoda.
Metivi: rauhu echav hakkohanim sheyyarad – vehem ratzu uvau, miharu vekiddeshu yedehem veraglehem min hakkiyyor.
b: Bishlama leabbaye demokem la kerabbi, umode rabbi demikkerot haggever ad tzafra la pasla lina – ha manni, rabbi hi.

Ella lerava demokem la kerabbi elazar berabbi shimon, aval lerabbi mikkerot haggever ad tzafra pasla lina; ha manni? i rabbi – pasla lina! i rabbi elazar berabbi shimon – ha amar: afillu mikkan vead asara yamim eno tzarich lekaddesh!
Leolam kerabbi elazar berabbi shimon, vehacha bemay askinan – bechahane chadte.

Ibbaya lehu: yetzia mahu shettoil bekiddush yadayim veraglayim? im timtze lomar lina la pasla – dela paresh, aval yetzia defaresh – assoche massach dateh; o dilma, kevan divyado lachazor – la massach?
Ta shema: kiddesh yadav veraglav venitmeu – matbilan veen tzarich lekaddesh. yatzu – hare hen bikdushshatan!
Yatzu yadav la kamibbaya lan, ki kamibbaya lan – yatza kol gufo. may?

Ta shema: shello rachutz yadayim veraglayim – mekaddesh bichle sharet bifnim. kiddesh bichle sharet bachutz o bichle chol bifnim o shettaval beme meara, veavad – avodato pesula. tama dekiddesh bichle sharet bachutz, ha kiddesh bifnim veyatza – avodato keshera!
Dilma "kiddesh bichle sharet bachutz" hechi dame – kegon deappek yadav levar vekiddesh; ha kiddesh bifnim veyatza, deappek yedeh levar – keshera. aval yatza kol gufo tibbee lach.
Amar leh rav zevid lerav pappa, ta shema: yatza chutz limchitzat chomat haazara – im lishhot, taun tevila; im lefi shaa, taun kiddush yadayim veraglayim!
Amar leh: hacha bemay askinan – kegon sheyyatza lehasech raglav ulehattil mayim.
Ha behedya katane la: kol hammesech raglav taun tevila, vechol hammetil mayim taun kiddush yadayim veraglayim! tane vahadar mefaresh.
Ta shema: para – rabbi chiyyay bar yosef amar: mekaddesh bichle sharet bifnim, veyotze. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu bachutz, vaafillu bichli chol, vaafillu bimkidda shel cheres!
Amar rav pappa: shane para – hoil vechol maaseha bachutz, la pasla bah yetzia. i hachi, lema li dimkaddesh? keen avoda penim.

Ibbaya lehu: tumea, mahu shettoil lekiddush yadayim veraglayim? im timtze lomar yetzia la pasla – degavra chaze, aval hacha degavra la chaze – assoche massach dateh; o dilma, kevan dahadar chaze – [dak leh] vela massach dateh?
Ta shema: kiddesh yadav veraglav venitmeu – matbilan, veen tzarich lekaddesh!
Nitmeu yadav la mibbaya lan, [ki mibbaya lan] nitma kol gufo. kol gufo?! tippok li: kevan devae lemebad heerev shemesh, assoche massach dateh! kegon deittammi samuch lishkiat hachamma.
Ta shema: para – rabbi chiyyay berabbi yosef amar: mekaddesh bichle sharet bifnim, veyotze. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu bachutz, vaafillu bichli chol, vaafillu bimkidda shel cheres.
